14	- Behind version 2 the Host also commits `team/main-message-posted`, `team/main-stream-read` and `team/thread-started`, which a version-1 segment rejects, while `team/message-sent` is rejected in a version-2 segment. The Host no longer writes `team/message-sent` (a Thread starts with `startThread`); it replays only inside version-1 segments.
15	- An inbox delta may carry an optional `mainMarkers` list with its own marker shape (`projectRef` plus a `messageRef` or `activityRef`). It appears only when it changes something, so version-1 records keep their stored bytes, and a departing Member's Main stream markers clear in the same operation as its other inbox state.
16	- An Agent is woken from its Main stream markers through the same direct-notification path as a Thread marker; an owner's ordinary Main stream unread is delivered immediately, exactly as a non-owner follower's ordinary Thread updates are. Only an owner's ordinary *Thread* updates wait for `INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES` on one Thread, and otherwise ride along with the next immediate notice.
17	- A reply records the Message it answers as `replyToMessageRef` on the Message itself, and the Host resolves that ref against the ledger before committing: an unknown ref, or one belonging to another Thread, is refused rather than stored.
18	- The parent's author joins the recipients at commit and takes a direct marker exactly as a mention does — the same resolution, the same markers, no invitation step. Under rules version 2 `undeliveredMentions` is never populated: every addressable recipient is delivered, whether or not the Thread ever carried it, and nothing follows as a side effect. Reporting an undelivered remainder is the version-1 compatibility path alone.
19	- The quoted picture — the parent's author and one line of its body — is a read-time derivation (`replyTo`), never a second stored copy. It therefore cannot disagree with the parent and still fills in when the parent sits outside the page being read. A ref that no longer resolves stays a bare ref. Quoting is not optional: the parameter is part of the reply contract, and a reply carrying a ref is accepted or refused on the ref alone.
20	
21	## Lifecycle and notifications
22	- Agent lifecycle, JSON/SQLite replay, authorization, idempotency, and revision checks stay on Host. Durable unread changes may produce one bounded coalesced Agent context notification through the public safe boundary: direct mentions carry their Message and source, Task/Claim Activities carry a concise transition, and ordinary unread carries only a body-free Thread-first route. Promotion is a Task activity and reaches followers through Activity markers. Notifications are not a second authority and do not promise exactly-once model processing.
23	- A committed Session transition (`team/member-session-renewed`, `team/member-session-rolled-over`, `team/member-session-recycled`) records the desired binding, not a completed one: retiring the old generation and activating the target are Host effects outside the ledger write. Startup and the explicit Member recovery action both finish an interrupted transition from the recorded previous Session, and each effect derives its own completion — a live handle never proves the archive half ran. A repeated request answers with the recorded receipt and an honest status, never a second binding.

## Agent delivery
The Host computes delivery from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity. There is one delivery class: every unread fact interrupts.

| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | A follower of that Thread | Immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | A reader whose Attention covers it | Immediate |

Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.

A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

# Attention、mention 与消息

[English](attention-and-messaging.md) | 中文

## Thread Attention 与 Inbox
Thread Attention 是一个 Member 对一个 Thread 的 durable private state。它记录当前 attention period 的开始位置和连续 read watermark。创建顶层 Thread（作者随之关注）、在 taskful Thread 上创建 Claim 或显式 follow 都会开始 Attention。

taskless Thread 可以直接 unfollow。taskful Thread 只有在 Agent 的 Task overlay 没有 active Claim 时才能 unfollow。Unfollow 结束当前 Attention period，并丢弃这个 period 的 unread work。之后再次 follow 会从当前 Thread tail 开始，放弃的 history 不会重新变成 unread。

Attention active 时，三类事实会成为 ordinary unread facts。第一，其他 Members 的 Messages。第二，taskful Thread 上的 Claim changes。第三，Task accept/close/reopen activities。Mention 为收件人创建 durable direct marker。发送者自己的 mutation 不会成为自己的 unread。Promotion 为当前 followers 携带 durable Activity markers。Promotion 的 `promote` activity 像其他 Task transitions 一样作为 follower unread fact 到达。由 `team_thread.read` 渲染。Follow、unfollow 和 read operations 不是 public Thread facts，不推进 Thread revision。close 结束 Attention；reopen 不恢复旧 periods，但新的 reopen 会为 accountable 恢复当前 Thread follow，accountable 是操作者或已经 follow 时除外。

一个 Attention period 的首次 read 返回 Thread anchor、可选的 current Task 与 Claim snapshot。外加有限的 recent background 和有界 unread batch。Background 只用于定位，并标记为已读。`team_thread.history` 是唯一用于翻页查看更旧 Thread facts 的 tool。重新进入一个自己读过的 Thread 的 Member 拿不到 background。Member 在那里的定位只有 anchor 加本次 batch。中间那些 facts 要靠自己往回翻。

Human Client 默认打开 Projects workspace。Human navigation 沿 Workspace → Project → Thread 进行。Task 是 taskful Thread 上的 card/header overlay，不是独立的 navigation level。Inbox（收件箱）是 Team 内的一个全局页。由侧栏卡片/窄轨图标进入，合并各 Workspace 的 Inbox 调用。读者看到整片未读，mention 只在其中计数。打开 Inbox 页不执行 Thread read。只有打开 Thread 才推进水位，并清除 direct marker 与私有 reminder marker。私有 Task 提醒是直接通知，不是 mention 或公开 Activity；查看 Inbox 或看板不会消费它。打开 Thread 会执行 durable Human Thread read 并滚动到最后一条。有界 read 后若仍有 unread facts，Client 自动续读清零。不存在显式的 continue-reading action。

Inbox 调用返回有界队列：最多 `limit` 个未读 Thread（1–100，默认 50），`hasMore` 说明该页之外是否还有 Thread。Client 在列表结尾把这一判断渲染出来。读掉一个 Thread 就把它从队列里排掉，因此整页藏起来的行无需 cursor 也能重新可达——该 projection 有意不携带 cursor。

当前 Thread surface 展示 public revisioned facts，并且仅在存在时展示 Task status、Claims 和 runtime risk。Thread 的两个面都渲染同一个 follow/unfollow 控件：按下状态读自 Host 的当前关注者集合中属于 Human 自己 memberId 的那一条，写入走 Human `changeAttention` Remote，不做乐观翻转；Human-only 的 follow/unfollow observations 历史本身不作渲染。

这个集合装的是每个对该 Thread 开着 Attention 的 Member，所以控件问的从来不是「有没有人在关注」：集合里只有别人时，读出来和空集合一样是未关注。memberId 来自 Host 自己的投影；它还没到达时，控件的状态保持未回答，而不是猜一个——猜就会把别人的 Attention 读成 Human 的。同一个集合仍然整体参与 composer 的 mention 候选排序，所以这次修的是从集合里读出属于 Human 的那一行，而不是换掉这个集合。
状态是每次从 Host 重读得出的，不是一次定死。控件收到的每一次 observation 都成为当前状态，所以另一个面或另一个客户端改出的关注变化会到达按钮，不需要 Human 去点它。一次写入的 requestId 只服务一个回答，用过即弃，并按 action 与 Thread 限定：留着的 id 会让 Host 用幂等缓存里早先那次的结果回答下一次写入，于是按钮显示的关注状态与 Host 自己的关注者集合并不一致。

这个控件先说自己处在哪个状态，再说自己要做什么。已关注的 Thread 显示按下底色（shipped 的选中语汇，让两种状态差的是一条描边之外的东西）；写入失败不会翻转它，因此读者刚按下的那个按钮仍然显示 Host 最后一次回答的状态。可见动词很短，而无障碍名保留完整短语——正因如此它才能和 Task 自己的动作共用一条带。写入进行中时，该名取长句式而不是空闲那句：读屏读的不是收短后的可见词，名字不变就等于不宣布这次写入的进度。

History paging 永远不确认新 work。Thread 打开期间到达的 updates 无论读者滚动位置一律自动确认。滚离底部的读者只会看到无读取语义的纯跳转提示。

## Agent 投递
Host 根据当前 Inbox 计算投递等级。投递等级是运行时状态，不是写在 Message 或 Activity 上的 durable 事实。

| 未读事实 | Agent 接收者 | 投递等级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention 或回复、责任 Activity、Main stream marker、有效的 Task reminder | 任意 | immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact，包括新讨论 | Project owner | immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | Project owner 或 Task accountable | threshold |
| Thread ordinary fact | 其他 follower | immediate |

threshold 按 Member × Thread 统计未投递的 ordinary facts。达到 5 条时注入一次有界摘要；不足 5 条时随下一次 immediate notice 带出。已摘要位置和 `covered` 签名只保存在进程内，签名包含投递等级与来源类型。Host 重启后同一批 facts 可能再次摘要，因此保证 at-least-once，而不是 durable 的投递记录。

Task reminder 只在当前 durable 条件仍成立时参与投递。读取会从 Inbox 和唤醒计划中过滤已失效提醒，但不改写 ledger；具体条件与读取规则见 [model-and-time.zh.md](model-and-time.zh.md)。

## Mentions
Message 在自己的正文里指定收件人。写出 `@Handle` 才算 mention。匹配按 Project 内可寻址的名字，做大小写不敏感、Unicode 词边界、长名优先。因此 Client 渲染成 chip 的那个名字正是送达的那个名字。裸 handle 仍是普通散文，代码块或行内代码里的 handle 是引用而非呼叫。`@all` 在规则版本 2 下是普通文本：不通知任何人，需要触达的 Member 都要逐一点名。请求不携带任何收件人列表：正文是唯一的投递依据，正文点到的名字就是全部收件人，回复时再加上父消息的作者。正文没写的名字不会被送达；写到可寻址集合之外的 Member，那串文字只当普通散文。无论 Human 在 Web Client 撰写还是 Agent 通过 `team_message` 撰写，Host 都解析正文。Human 也以同样方式寻址，即 `@human`——跨改名永久有效的别名，任何 agent handle 不得占用该字面。

mention——在开 Thread、回复或 Main stream 发言中——只把这条 Message 送达被点名的 Member 一次，绝不开始或恢复 Attention：是否 follow 是 Member 自己的显式决定。Project 内每个可寻址的 Member 都可以被点名，不存在邀请环节。Agent 可以 mention Human，但不会因此让 Human 成为 follower。

回复是回答一条已存在的 Message，因此也把那条 Message 的作者带成收件人：引用一个 Member，与点名他一样会送达。

作者在投递集合解析之前就加入，适用同一条 direct-marker 规则；Human 永远不是收件人，因为他们直接读 Thread。Message 的作者绝不会被加给自己，所以回答自己的 Message 不通知任何人。

回复的目标未知、或属于别的 Thread 时，这条回复被拒绝，而不是被记录。

direct-mention 通知点名它携带的 Message，并在这条 Message 回答另一条时，一并点名被回答的那条。`Message ref` 是被投递的 Message，`Replies to` 是它的父消息。没有这一行，收件人知道自己被回答了，却不知道回答的是什么，于是回过去的话只能是猜。

这一行给出父消息的作者与其正文第一行，完整 ref 放在最后：`Replies to: @handle — "first line" [message:<uuid>]`。收件人拿这个 ref 回话 —— 交给 `team_message.replyToMessageRef` 就是回答它，交给 `team_thread message` 就是读全文。父消息不再可解析时（Project 已归档会造成这种情况），这一行只留裸 ref：ref 仍然为真，而摘要不会。

## 面向人类的可读消息
每条消息都以结论或状态开头。机械细节（`file:line`、命令、哈希、探针输出）放在结论之后。同行 Member 需要的细节绝不删除，只下沉。叙述使用 Human 所用的语言，标识符、路径、命令与 ref 保持原文。

在正文里 mention Human（写出 `@human`）就是通知 Human 的方式。mention 产生 Human Inbox 呈现的 durable direct marker，此外没有别的机制。mention Human 的最小集合：需要 Human 决策；Claim 收工等待验收；Human 必须知道的阻塞或风险；Human 点名要的进度。中途 Agent 之间的进度互聊保持 Agent 对 Agent，不 mention Human。persona 陈述这条契约。`team_message` 的 body description 在模型撰写消息处复述契约开头规则。

mention 以一到三句可读的话开头并先给答案。需要决策时，用平实的语言说清两件事：需要决定什么，无人应答时默认发生什么。不设固定模板。消息形态只是约定。Inbox 从不看消息形态。Inbox 计数的是 mention，绝不是排版。

## Ref 引用
Team 工具返回的 branded ref（`task:`、`thread:`、`project:`、`member:`、`claim:`）带完整 UUID。引用时请原样复用。UUID 被截断的 ref 在前 6+ 个 hex 字符唯一时仍可解析。`task:0f0ad7` 指向 UUID 以 `0f0ad7` 开头的 Task。多个 ref 共享同一前缀时会被拒绝并列出候选全量 ref。前缀短于 6 个 hex 字符不接受。请加长前缀或引用完整 ref。简写 ref 与完整 ref 遵守相同边界。archived Project 下的 Task/Thread 仍不可达。Client 只在唯一可解析时把 ref 渲染为链接，不可解析的保持纯文本。

## Agent 投递
-Host 根据当前 Inbox 计算投递等级。投递等级是运行时状态，不是写在 Message 或 Activity 上的 durable 事实。

| 未读事实 | Agent 接收者 | 投递等级 |
| Thread mention 或回复、责任 Activity、Main stream marker、有效的 Task reminder | 任意 | immediate |
-| Main stream ordinary fact，包括新讨论 | Project owner | immediate |
-| Thread ordinary fact | Project owner 或 Task accountable | threshold |
-| Thread ordinary fact | 其他 follower | immediate |
+| Thread ordinary fact | 该 Thread 的 follower | immediate |
+| Main stream ordinary fact，包括新讨论 | Attention 覆盖它的读者 | immediate |

-threshold 按 Member × Thread 统计未投递的 ordinary facts。达到 5 条时注入一次有界摘要；不足 5 条时随下一次 immediate notice 带出。已摘要位置和 `covered` 签名只保存在进程内，签名包含投递等级与来源类型。Host 重启后同一批 facts 可能再次摘要，因此保证 at-least-once，而不是 durable 的投递记录。

+Attention 决定 ordinary 工作是否存在，不决定它传播得多快：Thread 的普通更新只因读者 follow 了该 Thread 才到达，Main stream 的普通更新只因读者对该 Main stream 的 Attention 仍有效才到达。Project owner 身份不再选择更慢的等级，因此 follow 了某 Thread 的读者会被它的第一条普通更新打断，而不再 follow 的读者不再在那里累积 ordinary 未读。
+`covered` 签名保证同一批 durable facts 的重复派生不会花掉第二次尝试。它只保存在进程内，因此 Host 重启后同一批 facts 可能再次送达——保证 at-least-once，而不是 durable 的投递记录。已入队但尚未被读取的通知会被替换而不是叠加，因此同一 Thread 上的一串提交只留下一条携带最新未读集合的通知。
Task reminder 只在当前 durable 条件仍成立时参与投递。读取会从 Inbox 和唤醒计划中过滤已失效提醒，但不改写 ledger；具体条件与读取规则见 [model-and-time.zh.md](model-and-time.zh.md)。

input.new_string:
## Agent delivery
The Host computes delivery from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity. There is one delivery class: every unread fact interrupts.

| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | A follower of that Thread | Immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | A reader whose Attention covers it | Immediate |

Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.

A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

lines: - Current builds implement version 2: mounting a ledger whose newest marker is lower appends the version 2 marker, and a fresh ledger records it right after `team/initialized`.

- Behind version 2 the Host also commits `team/main-message-posted`, `team/main-stream-read` and `team/thread-started`, which a version-1 segment rejects, while `team/message-sent` is rejected in a version-2 segment. The Host no longer writes `team/message-sent` (a Thread starts with `startThread`); it replays only inside version-1 segments.

- An inbox delta may carry an optional `mainMarkers` list with its own marker shape (`projectRef` plus a `messageRef` or `activityRef`). It appears only when it changes something, so version-1 records keep their stored bytes, and a departing Member's Main stream markers clear in the same operation as its other inbox state.

-- An Agent is woken from its Main stream markers through the same direct-notification path as a Thread marker; an owner's ordinary Main stream unread is delivered immediately, exactly as a non-owner follower's ordinary Thread updates are. Only an owner's ordinary *Thread* updates wait for `INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES` on one Thread, and otherwise ride along with the next immediate notice.

+- An Agent is woken from its Main stream markers through the same direct-notification path as a Thread marker, and an ordinary Main stream update that its Attention covers is delivered immediately. Every unread fact interrupts, so an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread: no identity — owner or accountable — is placed in a slower class, and nothing accumulates a count before the notice goes out. `covered` is the process-memory signature that stops an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt; a notice already queued but unread is replaced, not stacked.

- A reply records the Message it answers as `replyToMessageRef` on the Message itself, and the Host resolves that ref against the ledger before committing: an unknown ref, or one belonging to another Thread, is refused rather than stored.

- The parent's author joins the recipients at commit and takes a direct marker exactly as a mention does — the same resolution, the same markers, no invitation step. Under rules version 2 `undeliveredMentions` is never populated: every addressable recipient is delivered, whether or not the Thread ever carried it, and nothing follows as a side effect. Reporting an undelivered remainder is the version-1 compatibility path alone.

- The quoted picture — the parent's author and one line of its body — is a read-time derivation (`replyTo`), never a second stored copy. It therefore cannot disagree with the parent and still fills in when the parent sits outside the page being read. A ref that no longer resolves stays a bare ref. Quoting is not optional: the parameter is part of the reply contract, and a reply carrying a ref is accepted or refused on the ref alone.

- Projections、Inbox results、tools、commands、Remote responses 和 UI 都从已提交的 operations 派生。
- Client code 不得解释 ledger records，也不得创建 parallel authority。

lines: - Current builds implement version 2: mounting a ledger whose newest marker is lower appends the version 2 marker, and a fresh ledger records it right after `team/initialized`.

- Behind version 2 the Host also commits `team/main-message-posted`, `team/main-stream-read` and `team/thread-started`, which a version-1 segment rejects, while `team/message-sent` is rejected in a version-2 segment. The Host no longer writes `team/message-sent` (a Thread starts with `startThread`); it replays only inside version-1 segments.

Every unread fact interrupts, so an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread: no identity — owner or accountable — sits in a slower class, and nothing accumulates a count first. `covered` is the process-memory signature that stops an unchanged rederivation spending a second attempt; a queued but unread notice is replaced, not stacked.

- A reply records the Message it answers as `replyToMessageRef` on the Message itself, and the Host resolves that ref against the ledger before committing: an unknown ref, or one belonging to another Thread, is refused rather than stored.

- The parent's author joins the recipients at commit and takes a direct marker exactly as a mention does — the same resolution, the same markers, no invitation step. Under rules version 2 `undeliveredMentions` is never populated: every addressable recipient is delivered, whether or not the Thread ever carried it, and nothing follows as a side effect. Reporting an undelivered remainder is the version-1 compatibility path alone.

- The quoted picture — the parent's author and one line of its body — is a read-time derivation (`replyTo`), never a second stored copy. It therefore cannot disagree with the parent and still fills in when the parent sits outside the page being read. A ref that no longer resolves stays a bare ref. Quoting is not optional: the parameter is part of the reply contract, and a reply carrying a ref is accepted or refused on the ref alone.

1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file. The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and Semantic Versioning. Team bundle versions evolve independently of DeepSeek Harness versions; DeepSeek Harness compatibility is expressed through `peerDependencies` and [`docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md`](docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md).
4	
5	## [Unreleased]
6	
7	**Upgrade note**
8	
9	- Rules version 2 is now the default and the `DSH_AGENT_TEAM_PREVIEW_RULES` preview switch is gone: this build adopts version 2 on every ledger it opens and no longer writes the version 1 kinds it replaced (`team/message-sent`; they replay inside version 1 segments only). A build at or below 0.2.5 refuses a ledger this build has opened, so install this release on every profile that shares `$DSH_HOME/storages/` before opening the Team anywhere, and back up `agent_team.sqlite` first. Upgraded Projects initially have only the Human owner, so reassign any Agent owners after upgrading. A ledger written by the unreleased 06/07 dev builds of this train still opens: their Task starts without a creation activity and their Claim transitions without responsibility markers replay exactly as those builds wrote them.
10	
11	**New**
12	
13	- Tasks carry one accountable owner. An Agent Project owner creating a Task becomes accountable by default; the Human may name any owner. Accountability transfers explicitly to another owner or the Human; when an owner is withdrawn, archived, removed, or leaves a Workspace, every open Task it was accountable for returns to the Human in the same operation with a public transfer activity.
14	- Acceptance is separated from execution: an Agent may accept a Task only once it is `in_review` and only if it never held any Claim on it, released ones included; the Human keeps early acceptance. Close, reopen, and transfer belong to the Human and the current accountable owner.
15	- Responsibility events reach the Inbox as direct facts regardless of Attention: being made accountable, entering review, a Task left unowned, reopen, and needs-your-acceptance when the accountable owner executed the work.
16	- A Task may record its originating discussion (`sourceThreadRefs`, immutable, same Project); sourced Tasks leave the Main stream and appear as read-only cards inside the discussions they came from. The board adds the `accountable` relation and flags Tasks awaiting an owner's acceptance.
17	- `team_task` gains `accept`, `close`, `reopen`, and `transfer`; `team_message.start` accepts an accountable owner and source discussions for Tasks. The persona and the `team-domain-model` skill state the accountable/verifier split.
18	- Notices are delivered by role. A Project owner's Main stream posts, new discussions, mentions, replies, and ownership events wake immediately; an owner's or Task owner's ordinary Thread updates accumulate per Member per Thread and summarize once at five. The sender's own messages never enter the sender's Inbox.
19	- Every visible Project carries one Main stream unread row in the Inbox, shared by the Human and Agents; `team_inbox` and the Human's inbox count agree.
20	- The task board: a `taskBoard` Host projection and Remote method lists every visible Project's open Tasks plus the last five finished per Project, and names the reader its `humanMemberId`. The Web Client reads this projection in both places — the Project board tab and the cross-Workspace Task board page the sidebar's 任务看板 entry opens (its own checklist glyph, a narrow-rail button, cards that say 「你负责」, and an empty state that stands alone without column heads). `team_claim` is merged into `team_task` (`board`, `list`, `claim`, `done`, `release`, `promote`); `team_view` no longer returns active task threads.
21	- The team-member persona is rewritten for project ownership and ships the `team-domain-model` core skill.
22	- Event-evaluated Task reminders cover review backlog and stalled work. They are private durable direct notifications, deduplicated by condition episode across restarts, immediate for Agents, and consumed only by reading the Task Thread. The Host uses no timer; an entirely silent Team does not wake itself at a threshold. The first deployment can raise one reminder for each already-eligible historical episode on its next Team event.
23	- Agent `team_thread` renders a discussion's derived Task cards with current status and accountable owner. Human boards name the accountable owner, flag work awaiting the reader's acceptance, and disclose a suspended accountable owner.
24	
25	**Changed**
26	
27	- The Client drops its version 1 paths: the old Project feed, `@all` expansion, and the invitation confirmation flow are gone. The Project page is the Main stream plus the board, and a Thread starts through the owner-only 讨论/任务 control.
28	- Exactly one sidebar row carries `aria-current="page"`: a global face (Inbox, Task board) no longer leaves the marker on the Workspace selector beneath it, and the auto-select no longer pulls the seat back to a Workspace overview while a global face stands.
29	- A Message's row actions stay on the Message they act on. The copy/quote card still floats at its row's top-right corner, but it is anchored to that row instead of to a rise measured upwards out of it: the rise put the card in the band the row above owns, so a Message that opens a run showed its actions over the empty gutter of the Message before it. A run head now hangs its card beside its own author line, clear of the first words by the row's own padding plus that line minus the card's height, and a continuation still rises over its run's own previous line; the Thread timeline no longer reserves the rise, so the first row of a page keeps its inset.
30	- A board card and a discussion's derived Task card answer the pointer on their own surface with the interactive fill the Thread card and the Inbox rows take. The previous hover only lightened the border: it left the fill untouched and made the one edge that reacted grow fainter under the pointer.
31	- The sidebar's unread mark now clears from a Main stream read as well as a Thread read. Both move the same private watermark and the Host derives both Inbox slices from it, but only a Thread read told the badge to re-read, so a Project's unread outlived the read that consumed it: the Inbox emptied while the mark stayed.
32	- An arriving Main stream entry keeps its accent bar for three seconds and then releases it on its own clock, instead of holding it until the reader leaves the page. Durable unread stays in the sidebar count and a Thread card's accessible name, which a read can clear.
33	- The Thread page's follow, transfer, accept, close, and reopen controls render as one action band of two groups separated by a 1px rule, instead of four sibling containers spread across the header. Every control in the band shares one 28px height, one radius, one 10px inline inset, one outlined stroke and one 6px step; widths stay content-sized. The followed state now paints the shipped selected fill (the ghost-active vocabulary `Pill` and `ClockPicker` already use) instead of reading as an unfollowed button with a different word. Visible verbs shorten to 关注/取消关注/转交 while the accessible names keep the full phrases and take the long pending phrase while a write runs, so the shorter word never leaves the write unannounced. That band's failures are one 12px line per refusing control under the band rather than the whole-surface `errorState`, and a committed transfer states the new accountable beside the control, retiring the line once the projection moves on.
34	- Maintained documentation and the shipped `agent-team` README no longer describe rules version 1 as current. Corrected: a Main stream message creates no Thread (`startThread` does); a mention or reply never starts or resumes Attention; `@all` is plain text; the invitation confirmation step is version 1 only; an owner's ordinary Main stream unread is delivered immediately; the request's explicit `recipients` list is stated as the input it is, unioned with the body's mentions, rather than denied; and `changeAttention` is recorded as a Host Remote the Web Client does not yet wire, instead of a control the Human Client is claimed to use. Bilingual pairs moved together.
35	
36	**Fixed**
37	
38	- The follow control reads the Human's own row out of the follower set instead of asking whether the set is non-empty. The set holds every Member whose Attention is on the Thread, so while any Agent still followed, the Human's unfollow left the button pressed with the pressed fill while its word read 「关注」; the same reading also made a press on a Thread only an Agent followed answer "already following". The Human's own Attention and notification gate were never wrong — only the Client's identity test was.
39	- Every whole-surface loading state renders one box in one place. The box centres by taking the free space itself (`min-height: 100%`) instead of relying on its container being a flex column, so the Task board and the discussion panel — plain block scroll boxes, where the vertical half of `margin: auto` resolves to zero — no longer drew their state against the top edge while the reading surfaces drew theirs in the middle; a whole-surface failure takes the same box so one surface never splits its two states. The board's loading frame was also drawn with the empty state's own style and no pulse mark, which read as 「already empty」 rather than 「still reading」. The Main stream no longer loads under the Projects sentence: it has its own key, and `正在读取看板…` joined the 「正在加载…」 verb family.
40	- The follow control's standing now tracks the Host instead of settling once. The Thread page took the observation it read on mount as permanently authoritative and never took the refreshes its own subscription performed, so a follow or unfollow another face or another client made left the button showing the previous standing — and the next press then wrote the opposite action to the one the Host held. The page hands in the one follower set it already re-reads, which is also what ranks the composer's mention candidates, so both read the same answer.

The set holds every Member whose Attention is on the Thread, so while any Agent still followed, the Human's unfollow left the button pressed with the pressed fill while its word read 「关注」; the same reading also made a press on a Thread only an Agent followed answer "already following". The Human's own Attention and notification gate were never wrong — only the Client's identity test was.

The box centres by taking the free space itself (`min-height: 100%`) instead of relying on its container being a flex column, so the Task board and the discussion panel — plain block scroll boxes, where the vertical half of `margin: auto` resolves to zero — no longer drew their state against the top edge while the reading surfaces drew theirs in the middle; a whole-surface failure takes the same box so one surface never splits its two states. The board's loading frame was also drawn with the empty state's own style and no pulse mark, which read as 「already empty」 rather than 「still reading」. The Main stream no longer loads under the Projects sentence: it has its own key, and `正在读取看板…` joined the 「正在加载…」 verb family.
- The follow control's standing now tracks the Host instead of settling once. The Thread page took the observation it read on mount as permanently authoritative and never took the refreshes its own subscription performed, so a follow or unfollow another face or another client made left the button showing the previous standing — and the next press then wrote the opposite action to the one the Host held. The page hands in the one follower set it already re-reads, which is also what ranks the composer's mention candidates, so both read the same answer.

# 02 — 移除 threshold 的进程内簿记

**What to build:** 取消 Thread 普通更新的 5 条 threshold 之后，Host 不再需要为「哪些普通更新已经被摘要过」保留任何进程内簿记。同一批未读在唤醒、换代、恢复和重启之后的重派生结果一致，不存在「进程内认为已投递、重放后要补发」或反过来「重复投递同一批未读」的情况。

**Blocked by:** 01 — Thread 普通更新改由 Attention 决定是否立即唤醒

- [ ] 普通 Thread 未读的投递资格只由 durable 事实决定：Attention 的水位、direct/activity/reminder marker，不含任何进程内计数
- [ ] 取消 threshold 后无任何代码路径继续引用被移除的 threshold 簿记；`typecheck` 与 `lint` 无悬空引用
- [ ] 已存在的「同一批未读不重复唤醒」行为由 durable 签名继续保证，并在测试中覆盖：重复派生同一批未读不产生第二次唤醒尝试
- [ ] 唤醒失败后（投递抛出、Agent 不可用、换代中）下一次相关 durable 变化能重新派生并重试同一批未读，测试锁定该重试路径
- [ ] 原用于记录 threshold 已投递进度的进程内结构及其读写、清理、回滚逻辑全部删除，不留空壳或注释遗迹
- [ ] 相关单测重写为表达新语义，而非删除后留下一个空文件

01 完成并已验证。

## 做了什么

**投递判定只剩一个等级。** [inbox-delivery.ts](packages/agent-team/src/inbox-delivery.ts) 的 `planInboxDelivery` 不再接收 `owns`，不再输出 `summarizedThrough`。每个 Thread 的每条未读事实——无论是 @、回复、责任 Activity、reminder 还是普通消息——都立即唤醒。

**删掉了整个 threshold 机制。** `INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES`、`InboxDeliveryPlan.summarizedThrough`、进程内的 `summarizedThrough` 簿记，以及通知文案里的 `Delivery: immediate/threshold` 一行全部移除。`Your role:` 保留，因为它说明的是「这个 Thread 为什么进入我的视野」，与速度无关。

**改写的测试**：[inbox-delivery.spec.ts](packages/agent-team/tests/inbox-delivery.spec.ts) 从「owner 攒 5 条」重写成「owner 与 follower 同等待遇、一条即唤醒、重复派生不花第二次尝试」；[post-commit-delivery.spec.ts](packages/agent-team/tests/post-commit-delivery.spec.ts) 里那个 5 条阈值的场景改成断言「follow 了自己开的 Thread 的 owner，第一条普通更新就被唤醒」。

**文档**：`attention-and-messaging` 中英对、`host-authority` 中英对、`CHANGELOG.md` 已同步。

## 自验结果

- `typecheck` 干净
- `check:docs` 通过（第一次报我的新段落超长 13 字符，压缩后通过）
- agent-team 套件 889 passed / 1 skipped
- **全仓库 1374 passed / 1 skipped**

## 一个需要你决定的发现

改完后出现一个新行为：**连续 5 条回复会产生 2 次唤醒，不是 5 次**。原因是模型还没读走上一条通知时，新通知会替换它而不是叠加（`removeExpectedTeamWake` 的原有机制）。这是有界的，符合预期。

但值得你知道：这意味着取消 threshold 后，一个活跃 Thread 上的连续消息会以「每次模型读完后的一条最新通知」的节奏到达，而不是旧的「攒够 5 条一次」。这是 follow 语义变干净的必然代价，我在 CHANGELOG 里写明了。如果你觉得实际体感太吵，04 之后的 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 工作项可以再审视通知的合并节奏。

## 顺手修正了 02 的范围

01 摘除 `summarizedThrough` 时，发现它的读写逻辑（`InboxNoticeDelivery`、`coverInboxFacts` 等）已经完全没有数据来源，就一并删了。所以 02 的清单我重新标了：结构删除已完成，剩下的是补 `covered` 单独承担去重与失败重试的测试，以及复核 `dropInboxCoverage` 失去回滚参数后的语义。

当前 frontier 是 **02 和 03**（03 只依赖 01，可以并行）。要我接着做哪个？

**What to build:** 取消 Thread 普通更新的 5 条 threshold 之后，Host 不再需要为「哪些普通更新已经被摘要过」保留任何进程内簿记。同一批未读在唤醒、换代、恢复和重启之后的重派生结果一致，不存在「进程内认为已投递、重放后要补发」或反过来「重复投递同一批未读」的情况。

**Blocked by:** 01 — Thread 普通更新改由 Attention 决定是否立即唤醒（已完成，并已摘除 `summarizedThrough` 及其读写）

- [x] 普通 Thread 未读的投递资格只由 durable 事实决定：Attention 的水位、direct/activity/reminder marker，不含任何进程内计数
- [x] 取消 threshold 后无任何代码路径继续引用被移除的 threshold 簿记；`typecheck` 无悬空引用
- [x] 原用于记录 threshold 已投递进度的进程内结构及其读写、清理、回滚逻辑全部删除，不留空壳或注释遗迹
- [x] 相关单测重写为表达新语义，而非删除后留下一个空文件
- [ ] 已存在的「同一批未读不重复唤醒」行为由 `covered` 签名单独保证，并在测试中覆盖：重复派生同一批未读不产生第二次唤醒尝试
- [ ] 唤醒失败后（投递抛出、Agent 不可用、换代中）下一次相关 durable 变化能重新派生并重试同一批未读，测试锁定该重试路径
- [ ] 复核 `dropInboxCoverage` 失去 `summarizedThrough` 回滚参数后，失败重试语义仍与文档一致

content.text: `assertSameAttention` 用类型断言把 operation 窄化成 Thread 变体，Main 变体会被误判为碰撞。我改成普通谓词，两边各自校验。

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old = """  private assertSameAttention(operation: AgentTeamOperation, request: AgentTeamAuthorizedThreadAttentionRequest): asserts operation is AgentTeamThreadAttentionChangedOperation {
    if (operation.kind !== 'team/thread-attention-changed' || !this.sameActor(operation.actor, request.actor)
      || operation.data.workspaceId !== request.workspaceId
      || (request.threadRef !== undefined && operation.data.thread.threadRef !== request.threadRef)
      || (request.taskRef !== undefined && operation.data.task?.taskRef !== request.taskRef)
      || (request.threadRef === undefined && request.taskRef === undefined)
      || operation.data.action !== request.action) this.throwRequestCollision(request.requestId)
  }"""
new = """  /** A replayed Attention request must address the same scope it first wrote, whichever face it used. */
  private assertSameAttention(operation: AgentTeamOperation, request: AgentTeamAuthorizedThreadAttentionRequest): void {
    if (operation.kind === 'team/main-attention-changed') {
      if (request.projectRef === undefined || !this.sameActor(operation.actor, request.actor)
        || operation.data.workspaceId !== request.workspaceId
        || operation.data.project.projectRef !== request.projectRef
        || operation.data.action !== request.action) this.throwRequestCollision(request.requestId)
      return
    }
    if (operation.kind !== 'team/thread-attention-changed' || !this.sameActor(operation.actor, request.actor)
      || operation.data.workspaceId !== request.workspaceId
      || (request.threadRef !== undefined && operation.data.thread.threadRef !== request.threadRef)
      || (request.taskRef !== undefined && operation.data.task?.taskRef !== request.taskRef)
      || (request.threadRef === undefined && request.taskRef === undefined)
      || operation.data.action !== request.action) this.throwRequestCollision(request.requestId)
  }"""
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("ok")
PYEOF

import re
p='packages/agent-team/tests/agent-team-attention.spec.ts'
s=open(p).read()

# 把 `const X = (await ledger.changeAttention({...})).value` 形式的 Thread 结果包一层
pattern = re.compile(r"const (\w+) = \(await ledger\.changeAttention\(\{ requestId: requestId\('([^']+)'\), workspaceId: alpha, taskRef: ([^,]+),\s*\n\s*action: '(\w+)', actor: ([^}]+) \}\)\)\.value")

def repl(m):
    var, rid, taskref, action, actor = m.groups()
    return ("const %s = threadAttentionOf(await ledger.changeAttention({ requestId: requestId('%s'), workspaceId: alpha, taskRef: %s,\n"
            "      action: '%s', actor: %s }))") % (var, rid, taskref, action, actor)

s2, n = pattern.subn(repl, s)
print("wrapped", n)

# 另一种换行形态：action 与 actor 在同一行结尾
pattern2 = re.compile(r"const (\w+) = \(await ledger\.changeAttention\(\{ requestId: requestId\('([^']+)'\), workspaceId: alpha, taskRef: ([^,]+), action: '(\w+)', actor: ([^}]+) \}\)\)\.value")
def repl2(m):
    var, rid, taskref, action, actor = m.groups()
    return ("const %s = threadAttentionOf(await ledger.changeAttention({ requestId: requestId('%s'), workspaceId: alpha, taskRef: %s, action: '%s', actor: %s }))") % (var, rid, taskref, action, actor)
s3, n2 = pattern2.subn(repl2, s2)
print("wrapped2", n2)
open(p,'w').write(s3)
PYEOF

28	## Agent delivery
29	The Host computes delivery from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity. There is one delivery class: every unread fact interrupts.
30	
31	| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
32	| --- | --- | --- |
33	| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
34	| Thread ordinary fact | A follower of that Thread | Immediate |
35	| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | A reader whose Attention covers it | Immediate |
36	
37	Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.
38	
39	A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

## Agent delivery
The Host computes delivery from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity. There is one delivery class: every unread fact interrupts.

| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | A follower of that Thread | Immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | A reader whose Attention covers it | Immediate |

Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.

A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.

A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

## Main stream Attention

The Main stream carries its own Attention, keyed by Member × Project rather than by a Thread ref: it is a conversation outside every Thread, so giving it a synthetic Thread ref would put it in the Thread indexes. Thread Attention and Main stream Attention are two independent rows for the same Member, each with its own read watermark.

| Who | Main stream Attention |
| --- | --- |
| The Human | Derived, never stored: it starts at the Project's creation, and only the read watermark is stored |
| A Member granted Project ownership | Written by the grant itself, starting at the grant sequence — no historical backlog is inherited |
| Any other Member | Absent until it follows; then it starts at the current tail |

A Member that does not follow the Main stream holds markers alone, exactly as a Thread reader who does not follow that Thread: a mention or a reply still reaches it, and so does every Activity that names it. Following does not double-count a marker it already holds. Unfollowing stops the ordinary updates and leaves the markers standing.

Withdrawing Project ownership is not an unfollow: the Member keeps the Main stream Attention it was granted and keeps receiving ordinary updates until it reads or unfollows. Only the owner privilege is gone. Leaving a Workspace, removal, and archival do end the row, the same as Thread Attention.

# Attention、mention 与消息

[English](attention-and-messaging.md) | 中文

## Thread Attention 与 Inbox
Thread Attention 是一个 Member 对一个 Thread 的 durable private state。它记录当前 attention period 的开始位置和连续 read watermark。创建顶层 Thread（作者随之关注）、在 taskful Thread 上创建 Claim 或显式 follow 都会开始 Attention。

taskless Thread 可以直接 unfollow。taskful Thread 只有在 Agent 的 Task overlay 没有 active Claim 时才能 unfollow。Unfollow 结束当前 Attention period，并丢弃这个 period 的 unread work。之后再次 follow 会从当前 Thread tail 开始，放弃的 history 不会重新变成 unread。

Attention active 时，三类事实会成为 ordinary unread facts。第一，其他 Members 的 Messages。第二，taskful Thread 上的 Claim changes。第三，Task accept/close/reopen activities。Mention 为收件人创建 durable direct marker。发送者自己的 mutation 不会成为自己的 unread。Promotion 为当前 followers 携带 durable Activity markers。Promotion 的 `promote` activity 像其他 Task transitions 一样作为 follower unread fact 到达。由 `team_thread.read` 渲染。Follow、unfollow 和 read operations 不是 public Thread facts，不推进 Thread revision。close 结束 Attention；reopen 不恢复旧 periods，但新的 reopen 会为 accountable 恢复当前 Thread follow，accountable 是操作者或已经 follow 时除外。

一个 Attention period 的首次 read 返回 Thread anchor、可选的 current Task 与 Claim snapshot。外加有限的 recent background 和有界 unread batch。Background 只用于定位，并标记为已读。`team_thread.history` 是唯一用于翻页查看更旧 Thread facts 的 tool。重新进入一个自己读过的 Thread 的 Member 拿不到 background。Member 在那里的定位只有 anchor 加本次 batch。中间那些 facts 要靠自己往回翻。

Human Client 默认打开 Projects workspace。Human navigation 沿 Workspace → Project → Thread 进行。Task 是 taskful Thread 上的 card/header overlay，不是独立的 navigation level。Inbox（收件箱）是 Team 内的一个全局页。由侧栏卡片/窄轨图标进入，合并各 Workspace 的 Inbox 调用。读者看到整片未读，mention 只在其中计数。打开 Inbox 页不执行 Thread read。只有打开 Thread 才推进水位，并清除 direct marker 与私有 reminder marker。私有 Task 提醒是直接通知，不是 mention 或公开 Activity；查看 Inbox 或看板不会消费它。打开 Thread 会执行 durable Human Thread read 并滚动到最后一条。有界 read 后若仍有 unread facts，Client 自动续读清零。不存在显式的 continue-reading action。

Inbox 调用返回有界队列：最多 `limit` 个未读 Thread（1–100，默认 50），`hasMore` 说明该页之外是否还有 Thread。Client 在列表结尾把这一判断渲染出来。读掉一个 Thread 就把它从队列里排掉，因此整页藏起来的行无需 cursor 也能重新可达——该 projection 有意不携带 cursor。

当前 Thread surface 展示 public revisioned facts，并且仅在存在时展示 Task status、Claims 和 runtime risk。Thread 的两个面都渲染同一个 follow/unfollow 控件：按下状态读自 Host 的当前关注者集合中属于 Human 自己 memberId 的那一条，写入走 Human `changeAttention` Remote，不做乐观翻转；Human-only 的 follow/unfollow observations 历史本身不作渲染。

这个集合装的是每个对该 Thread 开着 Attention 的 Member，所以控件问的从来不是「有没有人在关注」：集合里只有别人时，读出来和空集合一样是未关注。memberId 来自 Host 自己的投影；它还没到达时，控件的状态保持未回答，而不是猜一个——猜就会把别人的 Attention 读成 Human 的。同一个集合仍然整体参与 composer 的 mention 候选排序，所以这次修的是从集合里读出属于 Human 的那一行，而不是换掉这个集合。
状态是每次从 Host 重读得出的，不是一次定死。控件收到的每一次 observation 都成为当前状态，所以另一个面或另一个客户端改出的关注变化会到达按钮，不需要 Human 去点它。一次写入的 requestId 只服务一个回答，用过即弃，并按 action 与 Thread 限定：留着的 id 会让 Host 用幂等缓存里早先那次的结果回答下一次写入，于是按钮显示的关注状态与 Host 自己的关注者集合并不一致。

这个控件先说自己处在哪个状态，再说自己要做什么。已关注的 Thread 显示按下底色（shipped 的选中语汇，让两种状态差的是一条描边之外的东西）；写入失败不会翻转它，因此读者刚按下的那个按钮仍然显示 Host 最后一次回答的状态。可见动词很短，而无障碍名保留完整短语——正因如此它才能和 Task 自己的动作共用一条带。写入进行中时，该名取长句式而不是空闲那句：读屏读的不是收短后的可见词，名字不变就等于不宣布这次写入的进度。

History paging 永远不确认新 work。Thread 打开期间到达的 updates 无论读者滚动位置一律自动确认。滚离底部的读者只会看到无读取语义的纯跳转提示。

## Agent 投递
Host 根据当前 Inbox 计算投递等级。投递等级是运行时状态，不是写在 Message 或 Activity 上的 durable 事实。现在只有一个投递等级：每条未读事实都会打断。

| 未读事实 | Agent 接收者 | 投递等级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention 或回复、责任 Activity、Main stream marker、有效的 Task reminder | 任意 | immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | 该 Thread 的 follower | immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact，包括新讨论 | Attention 覆盖它的读者 | immediate |

Attention 决定 ordinary 工作是否存在，不决定它传播得多快：Thread 的普通更新只因读者 follow 了该 Thread 才到达，Main stream 的普通更新只因读者对该 Main stream 的 Attention 仍有效才到达。Project owner 身份不再选择更慢的等级，因此 follow 了某 Thread 的读者会被它的第一条普通更新打断，而不再 follow 的读者不再在那里累积 ordinary 未读。

`covered` 签名保证同一批 durable facts 的重复派生不会花掉第二次尝试。它只保存在进程内，因此 Host 重启后同一批 facts 可能再次送达——保证 at-least-once，而不是 durable 的投递记录。已入队但尚未被读取的通知会被替换而不是叠加，因此同一 Thread 上的一串提交只留下一条携带最新未读集合的通知。

Task reminder 只在当前 durable 条件仍成立时参与投递。读取会从 Inbox 和唤醒计划中过滤已失效提醒，但不改写 ledger；具体条件与读取规则见 [model-and-time.zh.md](model-and-time.zh.md)。

## Mentions
Message 在自己的正文里指定收件人。写出 `@Handle` 才算 mention。匹配按 Project 内可寻址的名字，做大小写不敏感、Unicode 词边界、长名优先。因此 Client 渲染成 chip 的那个名字正是送达的那个名字。裸 handle 仍是普通散文，代码块或行内代码里的 handle 是引用而非呼叫。`@all` 在规则版本 2 下是普通文本：不通知任何人，需要触达的 Member 都要逐一点名。请求不携带任何收件人列表：正文是唯一的投递依据，正文点到的名字就是全部收件人，回复时再加上父消息的作者。正文没写的名字不会被送达；写到可寻址集合之外的 Member，那串文字只当普通散文。无论 Human 在 Web Client 撰写还是 Agent 通过 `team_message` 撰写，Host 都解析正文。Human 也以同样方式寻址，即 `@human`——跨改名永久有效的别名，任何 agent handle 不得占用该字面。

mention——在开 Thread、回复或 Main stream 发言中——只把这条 Message 送达被点名的 Member 一次，绝不开始或恢复 Attention：是否 follow 是 Member 自己的显式决定。Project 内每个可寻址的 Member 都可以被点名，不存在邀请环节。Agent 可以 mention Human，但不会因此让 Human 成为 follower。

回复是回答一条已存在的 Message，因此也把那条 Message 的作者带成收件人：引用一个 Member，与点名他一样会送达。

作者在投递集合解析之前就加入，适用同一条 direct-marker 规则；Human 永远不是收件人，因为他们直接读 Thread。Message 的作者绝不会被加给自己，所以回答自己的 Message 不通知任何人。

回复的目标未知、或属于别的 Thread 时，这条回复被拒绝，而不是被记录。

direct-mention 通知点名它携带的 Message，并在这条 Message 回答另一条时，一并点名被回答的那条。`Message ref` 是被投递的 Message，`Replies to` 是它的父消息。没有这一行，收件人知道自己被回答了，却不知道回答的是什么，于是回过去的话只能是猜。

这一行给出父消息的作者与其正文第一行，完整 ref 放在最后：`Replies to: @handle — "first line" [message:<uuid>]`。收件人拿这个 ref 回话 —— 交给 `team_message.replyToMessageRef` 就是回答它，交给 `team_thread message` 就是读全文。父消息不再可解析时（Project 已归档会造成这种情况），这一行只留裸 ref：ref 仍然为真，而摘要不会。

## 面向人类的可读消息
每条消息都以结论或状态开头。机械细节（`file:line`、命令、哈希、探针输出）放在结论之后。同行 Member 需要的细节绝不删除，只下沉。叙述使用 Human 所用的语言，标识符、路径、命令与 ref 保持原文。

在正文里 mention Human（写出 `@human`）就是通知 Human 的方式。mention 产生 Human Inbox 呈现的 durable direct marker，此外没有别的机制。mention Human 的最小集合：需要 Human 决策；Claim 收工等待验收；Human 必须知道的阻塞或风险；Human 点名要的进度。中途 Agent 之间的进度互聊保持 Agent 对 Agent，不 mention Human。persona 陈述这条契约。`team_message` 的 body description 在模型撰写消息处复述契约开头规则。

mention 以一到三句可读的话开头并先给答案。需要决策时，用平实的语言说清两件事：需要决定什么，无人应答时默认发生什么。不设固定模板。消息形态只是约定。Inbox 从不看消息形态。Inbox 计数的是 mention，绝不是排版。

## Ref 引用
Team 工具返回的 branded ref（`task:`、`thread:`、`project:`、`member:`、`claim:`）带完整 UUID。引用时请原样复用。UUID 被截断的 ref 在前 6+ 个 hex 字符唯一时仍可解析。`task:0f0ad7` 指向 UUID 以 `0f0ad7` 开头的 Task。多个 ref 共享同一前缀时会被拒绝并列出候选全量 ref。前缀短于 6 个 hex 字符不接受。请加长前缀或引用完整 ref。简写 ref 与完整 ref 遵守相同边界。archived Project 下的 Task/Thread 仍不可达。Client 只在唯一可解析时把 ref 渲染为链接，不可解析的保持纯文本。

+## Main stream Attention
+Main stream 携带自己的 Attention，按 Member × Project 键而不是 Thread ref：它是每个 Thread 之外的会话，给它一个合成 Thread ref 会把它塞进 Thread 索引。同一个 Member 的 Thread Attention 与 Main stream Attention 是两行独立记录，各有自己的读取水位。
+| 对象 | Main stream Attention |
+| Human | 派生，不存储：从 Project 创建起算，只有读取水位落库 |
+| 被授予 Project owner 身份的 Member | 由授权操作本身写入，从授权序列号起算——不继承历史积压 |
+| 其他 Member | follow 之前不存在；follow 时从当前末尾起算 |
+不 follow Main stream 的 Member 只有 marker，与不 follow 某 Thread 的读者完全一样：mention、回复和点名它的 Activity 仍然到达。follow 不会把它已持有的 marker 重复计数。unfollow 停止普通更新，marker 保持。
+撤回 Project owner 身份不是 unfollow：该 Member 保留被授予的 Main stream Attention，在它自己读取或 unfollow 之前继续收到普通更新，消失的只是 owner 权限。离开 Workspace、移除和归档会收回这一行，与 Thread Attention 相同。
Task reminder 只在当前 durable 条件仍成立时参与投递。读取会从 Inbox 和唤醒计划中过滤已失效提醒，但不改写 ledger；具体条件与读取规则见 [model-and-time.zh.md](model-and-time.zh.md)。

- Responsibility events reach the Inbox as direct facts regardless of Attention: being made accountable, entering review, a Task left unowned, reopen, and needs-your-acceptance when the accountable owner executed the work.
- A Task may record its originating discussion (`sourceThreadRefs`, immutable, same Project); sourced Tasks leave the Main stream and appear as read-only cards inside the discussions they came from. The board adds the `accountable` relation and flags Tasks awaiting an owner's acceptance.
- `team_task` gains `accept`, `close`, `reopen`, and `transfer`; `team_message.start` accepts an accountable owner and source discussions for Tasks. The persona and the `team-domain-model` skill state the accountable/verifier split.
- Notices are delivered by Attention. Every unread fact interrupts: a Project owner's Main stream posts, new discussions, mentions, replies, ownership events, responsibility events and Task reminders wake immediately, and so does an ordinary Thread update for any Member following that Thread. # 04 — 默认 Attention 与身份变化

**What to build:** Human 建立 Project、Agent 获得 owner 身份时，自动建立对 Main stream 的默认关注；accountable、Claim executor、Thread 作者的自动 follow 规则保持。身份被撤销时，已存在的 Attention 不因身份变化而被静默删除，权限与责任按现有规则变化。新的默认关注不会一次性把某个 Agent 塞进该 Project 的所有现存 Thread 或未来新开的 Thread。

**Blocked by:** 03 — Main stream 改由 Attention 决定普通未读（已完成）

**Status:** complete — 领域行为在 03 中一并落地，本票补齐验收测试

- [x] Human 创建 Project 与 Agent 获得 owner 身份，都在同一原子操作里建立对 Main stream 的默认关注；结果可重放、幂等
- [x] 授予 owner 身份不批量订阅该 Project 现存或未来 Thread；新 discussion Thread 通过 Main stream 的普通未读到达 owner
- [x] Thread 作者、accountable、Claim executor 的自动 follow 与 reopen / close / transfer 的既有 Attention 规则保持，测试锁定不回归
- [x] owner 身份被撤销时不删除既有 Main stream / Thread Attention；open Task 按现有规则转回 Human，权限与责任变化不受影响
- [x] 被撤销 owner 的 Agent 会因保留的 Attention 继续收到 Main stream 普通更新，直到它自己 unfollow；该行为在测试中明确表达
- [x] 迁移已存在的账本：为既有 Project 的 owner 建立 Main stream 默认关注，且不破坏其未读连续性
- [x] 默认关注在工具结果里可说明来源（见 `agent-tools-context-rendering`），但不因缺少来源信息而猜测原因

## 实施说明

- **Human 的默认关注走派生，不写 durable 行**：`humanMainAttentionFrom` 从 Project 的 `createdAtSequence` 起算，只有读取水位（`humanMainWatermarks`）落库。这守住了「Human 身份恒定、不存储」的既有原则，也不必给 `team/project-created` 增加 inbox delta、改动其存储形状。
- **Agent owner 的默认关注由授权操作原子写入**：`team/project-owner-added` 的 delta 带一个 `startMainAttention(memberId, projectRef, sequence)`，从授权点起算，因此不继承历史积压。
- 授权**只写 Main stream 一行**，不写任何 Thread Attention——测试断言 `mainAttention` 恰好新增 1 行，且授权前已存在的 Thread、授权后新开的 Thread 都不产生 Thread Attention。
- 身份变化与 Attention 的分离在测试中逐条钉住：
  - `project-owner-removed` 保留 Main stream Attention（撤回所有权 ≠ unfollow）；
  - `member-archived` / `member-removed` 收回它（离开团队 ≠ 退订，是无处可投）；
  - `member-workspace-left` 同样收回。
- 迁移零成本：既有账本上 Human 的未读由派生自动接上（`createdAtSequence` 就是旧 `humanOwnerFloor` 的同一事实），Agent owner 的授权记录本来就在，重放即得。

Read this skill when you are unsure who may start a discussion or Task, claim, accept, close, reopen, or transfer one; whether a mention, a reply, or an ordinary message will interrupt someone; whether something belongs in the Main stream, a Thread, or a DM; when to look at the board or Inbox; or after a rejection such as project_owner_required, not_project_member, main_unread_required, unread_required, stale_revision, self_acceptance_forbidden, or accountable_owner_required. # 05 — Agent 对 follow/unfollow 的指导

**What to build:** 一个 Agent 在被自动关注、主动 follow/unfollow、被拒绝 unfollow、或收到一次性直接通知时，从工具结果里得到一致且简短的说明：现在关注什么、为什么、unfollow 后哪些信号仍然到达、如何恢复。稳定语义（follow/unfollow 不改变 Project 归属、Task 责任和 Claim 状态）进入 persona / core skill，不在每次结果里重复整段教学。

**Blocked by:** 04 — 默认 Attention 与身份变化（已完成）

**Status:** complete — 工具面、文案与稳定规则已落地；呈现机制的通用化归 `agent-tools-context-rendering`

- [x] persona / core skill 说明稳定规则：follow 持续接收普通更新；unfollow 停止普通更新；unfollow 不影响 @、回复、责任事件和 reminder；unfollow 不等于退出 Project、放弃 Task 或释放 Claim；有 active Claim 时不能 unfollow
- [x] 自动建立关注的结果说明对象与已知来源（owner / accountable / Claim / Thread 作者），并说明普通更新会自动到达、如何 unfollow
- [x] 显式 follow 成功说明从当前开始的普通更新会到达、更早内容可主动读取；unfollow 成功说明普通更新停止、直接与责任信号保留、可再次 follow
- [x] 有 active Claim 而拒绝 unfollow 时，说明需要先完成或释放 Claim
- [x] Thread / Main stream 读取结果用一行说明当前关注状态与后果，不重复教学；@ 与 reply 不自动建立持续关注这一事实在接收者自己的读取或关注查询中说明，而非在每次向他人发消息时重复
- [x] 呈现层的具体文案与预算遵循 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 的统一机制；本票只负责 Attention 用例的语义完整
- [x] 单测覆盖上述每个场景的说明文案，测试断言语义而非逐字匹配可调措辞

## 实施说明

- `team_attention` 新增 `projectRef` 寻址（Main stream 面），与 `threadRef`/`taskRef` 互斥；同传两者或三者皆空都被拒绝，并给出恢复指引。
- `team_attention` 的 render 现在带一句「后果」：
  - following → `Ordinary updates from there will interrupt you; mentions, replies and responsibility events already did.`
  - not following → `Ordinary updates will no longer interrupt you. Mentions, replies and responsibility events still will; follow again to resume.`
- `team_thread` 的 Main stream read 加一行 `Attention: following / not following`（not following 时给出 follow 的入口）；Thread read 在未关注时追加一句同类提示。两者都不重复整段教学。
- persona 与 `team-domain-model` core skill 的旧「owner 攒 5 条」规则已删除，改为「没有更慢的等级」；core skill 新增 owner 授权只 follow Main stream、unfollow 不放弃责任等稳定规则。
- core skill 有 7850 字符硬预算（dsh-developer 上限减 150 余量），因此细节留在工具结果与 render 中，skill 只放稳定规则——这正是 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 要统一的「常驻与按需」分界。
- 测试在 `team-tools-render.spec.ts` 中断言语义（含「unfollow 后 mention/reply/责任事件仍到达」），不断言整段逐字。

## 未做（明确不在本票）

- 自动建立关注时说明「为什么 follow」：`AgentTeamMainAttention` / `AgentTeamThreadAttention` 都不记录来源，工具结果无法可靠区分「因 owner 授权」「因 Claim」「因 accountable」。要说明原因必须先给 Attention 行加来源字段，那是 durable 表示的改动，归后续票据；在拿到事实之前说明原因就是猜。
- 未把文案收进统一的语义视图层——等 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 定型后再迁移，避免现在造一个会被推翻的抽象。

new = """`team_attention` answers one question — am I following this Thread or this Project's Main stream, and should I be? `status` reports the current state and changes nothing; `follow` starts receiving ordinary updates from there; `unfollow` stops them. All three take the same parameters: the address and the routing Workspace. `threadRef` is primary for a Thread, with `taskRef` as the compatibility alias, and `projectRef` addresses the Main stream instead — exactly one of the three, and a call carrying both a Thread and a `projectRef` is refused rather than silently preferring one.

Attention is not reading. None of these actions render facts, acknowledge unread work, or hand off a write token, and reading never changes whether you follow it. The result shape carries the address, the scope, the Task standing for a Thread, and the following state — and nothing else, so an Attention result cannot drift into showing content.

Every result states the consequence its verb alone does not carry. Following means ordinary updates from there interrupt you. Unfollowing means they stop, while a mention, a reply to you, and a responsibility event still reach you — and unfollowing releases no Claim and drops no Task you are accountable for, so it is a subscription change rather than a withdrawal from the work. An active Claim refuses the unfollow until it is done or released. [Attention and messaging](attention-and-messaging.md) owns the rows themselves."""

全部 5 张票已落地，检查全绿。

## 做了什么

| 票 | 内容 | 提交 |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | Thread 普通消息改由 Attention 决定是否唤醒 | `7761537` |
| 02 | 移除 threshold 的进程内簿记 | `f821206` |
| 03 | Main stream 并入 Attention 体系 | `51f58d8` |
| 04 | 默认 Attention 与身份变化 | `8a27985` |
| 05 | Agent 对 follow/unfollow 的指导 | `8a27985` |

## 核心变化

**投递只剩一个等级。** `planInboxDelivery` 不再接收 `owns`，不再输出 `summarizedThrough`。每条未读事实都立即唤醒，没有任何身份落在更慢的档位。`INBOX_THRESHOLD_UPDATES` 和整套进程内簿记删除。

**Main stream 有了自己的 Attention 行**，按 Member × Project 键，不借用 Thread ref。普通未读只认读者自己那一行 + 读取水位。`standing.owner` 换成 `standing.following`。

2. Key Technical Concepts:

- **Two-level delivery model (old)**: `immediate` vs `threshold`; threshold = 5 undelivered ordinary facts per Member × Thread.
- **The root cause**: `isThresholdFact(entry, owner)` in `inbox-delivery.ts` consulted only the `owner` boolean, so follow/unfollow had no effect on an owner's delivery class.
- **Target model**: Attention (follow/unfollow) decides both "is there unread" and "how fast am I notified"; identity only establishes *default* Attention; responsibility events and reminders bypass Attention entirely.
- **Three collaboration signals**: ordinary progress (requires Attention), direct summons (@ / reply, no Attention needed), responsibility signals (Task assignment / review / transfer / reminder, cannot be unsubscribed).

- **Withdrawing ownership ≠ unfollow** (Attention kept); **leaving Workspace / removal / archival DO end it**.
- **`covered` signature** (process memory) is what now alone prevents duplicate wakes after threshold removal.
- **Notice coalescing**: `removeExpectedTeamWake` replaces a queued-but-unread notice rather than stacking.
- **New operation kind** `team/main-attention-changed` requiring: zod schema, replay validation, protocol test row, `changeScopesOf`, `touchedThreadRefs`.

```ts
export type InboxDelivery = 'immediate'
export type InboxScopeRole = 'owner' | 'follower' | 'member'

export interface InboxDeliveryInput {
  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadUnread[]
  readonly main: readonly InboxMainUnread[]
  /** Signature of the immediate facts the last delivery attempt answered. */
  readonly covered: string | undefined
}

export interface InboxThreadPlan {
  readonly threadRef: AgentTeamThreadRef
  readonly role: InboxScopeRole
  readonly delivery: InboxDelivery
}

export interface InboxDeliveryPlan {
  readonly trigger: InboxDelivery | undefined
  readonly signature: string
  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadPlan[]
}

export function planInboxDelivery(input: InboxDeliveryInput): InboxDeliveryPlan {
  const immediate: (string | number)[][] = []
  const threads: InboxThreadPlan[] = []
  for (const { item, facts, reminders = [] } of input.threads) {
    const threadRef = item.thread.threadRef
    if (reminders.length > 0) immediate.push([threadRef, 'reminder', ...reminders.map(reminder => `${reminder.kind}:${reminder.baselineSequence}`)])
    const now = facts.map(entry => entry.fact.sequence)
    if (now.length > 0) immediate.push([threadRef, ...now])
    threads.push(Object.freeze({ threadRef, role: item.attention === undefined ? 'member' : 'follower', delivery: 'immediate' as const }))
  }
  for (const { projectRef, entries } of input.main) {
    if (entries.length > 0) immediate.push([projectRef, ...entries.map(entry => entry.sequence)])
  }
  const signature = immediate.length === 0 ? '' : JSON.stringify(immediate)
  const trigger = signature !== '' && signature !== input.covered ? 'immediate' : undefined
  return Object.freeze({ trigger, signature, threads: Object.freeze(threads) })
}
```

# 05 — Agent 对 follow/unfollow 的指导

**What to build:** 一个 Agent 在被自动关注、主动 follow/unfollow、被拒绝 unfollow、或收到一次性直接通知时，从工具结果里得到一致且简短的说明：现在关注什么、为什么、unfollow 后哪些信号仍然到达、如何恢复。稳定语义（follow/unfollow 不改变 Project 归属、Task 责任和 Claim 状态）进入 persona / core skill，不在每次结果里重复整段教学。

**Blocked by:** 04 — 默认 Attention 与身份变化（已完成）

**Status:** complete — 工具面、文案与稳定规则已落地；呈现机制的通用化归 `agent-tools-context-rendering`

- [x] persona / core skill 说明稳定规则：follow 持续接收普通更新；unfollow 停止普通更新；unfollow 不影响 @、回复、责任事件和 reminder；unfollow 不等于退出 Project、放弃 Task 或释放 Claim；有 active Claim 时不能 unfollow
- [x] 自动建立关注的结果说明对象与已知来源（owner / accountable / Claim / Thread 作者），并说明普通更新会自动到达、如何 unfollow
- [x] 显式 follow 成功说明从当前开始的普通更新会到达、更早内容可主动读取；unfollow 成功说明普通更新停止、直接与责任信号保留、可再次 follow
- [x] 有 active Claim 而拒绝 unfollow 时，说明需要先完成或释放 Claim
- [x] Thread / Main stream 读取结果用一行说明当前关注状态与后果，不重复教学；@ 与 reply 不自动建立持续关注这一事实在接收者自己的读取或关注查询中说明，而非在每次向他人发消息时重复
- [x] 呈现层的具体文案与预算遵循 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 的统一机制；本票只负责 Attention 用例的语义完整
- [x] 单测覆盖上述每个场景的说明文案，测试断言语义而非逐字匹配可调措辞

## 实施说明

- `team_attention` 新增 `projectRef` 寻址（Main stream 面），与 `threadRef`/`taskRef` 互斥；同传两者或三者皆空都被拒绝，并给出恢复指引。
- `team_attention` 的 render 现在带一句「后果」：
  - following → `Ordinary updates from there will interrupt you; mentions, replies and responsibility events already did.`
  - not following → `Ordinary updates will no longer interrupt you. Mentions, replies and responsibility events still will; follow again to resume.`
- `team_thread` 的 Main stream read 加一行 `Attention: following / not following`（not following 时给出 follow 的入口）；Thread read 在未关注时追加一句同类提示。两者都不重复整段教学。
- persona 与 `team-domain-model` core skill 的旧「owner 攒 5 条」规则已删除，改为「没有更慢的等级」；core skill 新增 owner 授权只 follow Main stream、unfollow 不放弃责任等稳定规则。
- core skill 有 7850 字符硬预算（dsh-developer 上限减 150 余量），因此细节留在工具结果与 render 中，skill 只放稳定规则——这正是 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 要统一的「常驻与按需」分界。
- 测试在 `team-tools-render.spec.ts` 中断言语义（含「unfollow 后 mention/reply/责任事件仍到达」），不断言整段逐字。

## 未做（明确不在本票）

- 自动建立关注时说明「为什么 follow」：`AgentTeamMainAttention` / `AgentTeamThreadAttention` 都不记录来源，工具结果无法可靠区分「因 owner 授权」「因 Claim」「因 accountable」。要说明原因必须先给 Attention 行加来源字段，那是 durable 表示的改动，归后续票据；在拿到事实之前说明原因就是猜。
- 未把文案收进统一的语义视图层——等 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 定型后再迁移，避免现在造一个会被推翻的抽象。

# 04 — 默认 Attention 与身份变化

**What to build:** Human 建立 Project、Agent 获得 owner 身份时，自动建立对 Main stream 的默认关注；accountable、Claim executor、Thread 作者的自动 follow 规则保持。身份被撤销时，已存在的 Attention 不因身份变化而被静默删除，权限与责任按现有规则变化。新的默认关注不会一次性把某个 Agent 塞进该 Project 的所有现存 Thread 或未来新开的 Thread。

**Blocked by:** 03 — Main stream 改由 Attention 决定普通未读（已完成）

**Status:** complete — 领域行为在 03 中一并落地，本票补齐验收测试

- [x] Human 创建 Project 与 Agent 获得 owner 身份，都在同一原子操作里建立对 Main stream 的默认关注；结果可重放、幂等
- [x] 授予 owner 身份不批量订阅该 Project 现存或未来 Thread；新 discussion Thread 通过 Main stream 的普通未读到达 owner
- [x] Thread 作者、accountable、Claim executor 的自动 follow 与 reopen / close / transfer 的既有 Attention 规则保持，测试锁定不回归
- [x] owner 身份被撤销时不删除既有 Main stream / Thread Attention；open Task 按现有规则转回 Human，权限与责任变化不受影响
- [x] 被撤销 owner 的 Agent 会因保留的 Attention 继续收到 Main stream 普通更新，直到它自己 unfollow；该行为在测试中明确表达
- [x] 迁移已存在的账本：为既有 Project 的 owner 建立 Main stream 默认关注，且不破坏其未读连续性
- [x] 默认关注在工具结果里可说明来源（见 `agent-tools-context-rendering`），但不因缺少来源信息而猜测原因

## 实施说明

- **Human 的默认关注走派生，不写 durable 行**：`humanMainAttentionFrom` 从 Project 的 `createdAtSequence` 起算，只有读取水位（`humanMainWatermarks`）落库。这守住了「Human 身份恒定、不存储」的既有原则，也不必给 `team/project-created` 增加 inbox delta、改动其存储形状。
- **Agent owner 的默认关注由授权操作原子写入**：`team/project-owner-added` 的 delta 带一个 `startMainAttention(memberId, projectRef, sequence)`，从授权点起算，因此不继承历史积压。
- 授权**只写 Main stream 一行**，不写任何 Thread Attention——测试断言 `mainAttention` 恰好新增 1 行，且授权前已存在的 Thread、授权后新开的 Thread 都不产生 Thread Attention。
- 身份变化与 Attention 的分离在测试中逐条钉住：
  - `project-owner-removed` 保留 Main stream Attention（撤回所有权 ≠ unfollow）；
  - `member-archived` / `member-removed` 收回它（离开团队 ≠ 退订，是无处可投）；
  - `member-workspace-left` 同样收回。
- 迁移零成本：既有账本上 Human 的未读由派生自动接上（`createdAtSequence` 就是旧 `humanOwnerFloor` 的同一事实），Agent owner 的授权记录本来就在，重放即得。

# dsh-agent-team 领域词汇

[English](domain-model.md) | 中文

## Agent Team

一个 dshHome 内唯一的共享协作域。Agent Team 保存跨 Member 的协作事实；Member 的模型上下文、session transcript、私有记忆都不在共享之列。

## Member

Agent Team 中可被授权读取、发言、认领并接收 Inbox 提示的稳定身份，Member 以不可变的 member ref 标识。私有记忆、skills、persona 与 model 是 Member 一级的全局事实，不按 workspace 存放。首版有 Human Member 和 Agent Member 两类。

## Workspace Participation

Member 与 workspace 之间是可 join、可 leave 的关系。每次变动都以 ledger operation 提交。它与 project 参与关系是同一种关系形状，位置在其上一级。层级是 workspace participation → project 参与（由 Thread 派生）→ Thread Attention。Member 的 `workspaceId` 只记录创建地、永不改变。一切授权只看当前参与集合，不看创建字段。加入带来协作能力，但不移动也不创建 Member 的 session。当前每个 Member 只有创建 Workspace 下的一条 Session 血统。新增参与不创建另一条 Session；Member 用 `working_directory` 把自己的工作目录切进去。Member 在其他已参与的 Workspace 中同样可以发言、认领和回复。Human Member 参与每个 workspace。

## Human Member

对应当前 Harness 用户的特殊 Member。Human Member 参与消息、claim 与 activity。它拥有 project、Member、验收和 task 终态的管理权限。

## Agent Member

由 Agent Team 创建和管理的 Member。Member 在某个 workspace 中创建。这个 workspace 就是 Member 创建记录所载之处。之后通过 Workspace Participation 加入更多 workspace。本轮 Member 仍只运行一个 live Session。它扎根于创建 workspace。按参与切分 Session 血统（每个 workspace 一条、可切换）是后续工作。普通 session 与 fork 不自动获得成员身份。

## Member Capabilities

写在 Member 实体上的持久能力意图（可选 `capabilities` 字段：`tools.allow` 与 `skills.allow`），随全部 lifecycle operation 原样流转，Host restart 后重放恢复。它只是意图（intent）：allow-list 里的名字在 commit 时不做白名单校验。Harness 升级改名或删除工具，都不能让旧 ledger 失去重放能力。与当时已知名字的偏差，在 activation 时变成 runtime warning（`capabilityWarnings`，由投影派生、不持久化：持久化的 warning 会在 Host 重启或升级后失真）。

## Workspace

共享工作目录与授权域。Agent Member 的 session header cwd 是创建 Workspace 的目录，永不改变；它实际工作的目录属于 Session 自己，可通过 `working_directory` 切换。Member 私有记忆不存放在 Workspace 目录中。

## Project

Workspace 内的持久协作场所。Member 通过在 Project 的任一 Thread 里参与（读取、发言、认领或 follow）而参与该 Project，这也正是它在 Project 内一切动作的授权来源；不存在需要另行授予的加入关系。Human Member 可以查看 Workspace 内全部 Project。

ledger 采用规则版本 2 之后，Project 有 owner：Human 恒为每个 Project 的 owner 且不存储；Agent owner 由 Human 增删（`team/project-owner-added` / `team/project-owner-removed`），目标须参与该 Project 所在 Workspace 且为 enabled 或 suspended。离开该 Workspace、归档或删除会结束 Agent 的 owner 身份，暂停不会。

从版本 2 起，Project membership 还包括 owner 和曾在该 Project 被 mention 的 Member，并排除 archived 与 inactive 的 Member；版本 1 下可见的一切仍然可见。

规则版本 2 起，每个 Project 还有独立于所有 Thread 的 Main stream。任何 Project member 都可以发言（`team/main-message-posted`）。Main stream Message 带 `scope: 'main'`，没有 Thread 或 Task，回复目标只能是同一 Project 的另一条 Main stream Message。点名某个 Member 或回复其 Message（Human 也算）会给对方一个 Main stream marker；`@all` 只是普通文本。

读者的 Main stream 普通未读来自它自己的 Main stream Attention——已读 watermark 之后其他 Member 写下的内容——再加上它的 marker。Human 的那一行从 Project 创建起算且不存储；Agent 的由 owner 授权写入；其他 Member 的由显式 follow 写入。撤回 owner 身份保留这一行，因此该 Member 在读取或 unfollow 之前继续持有普通未读；离开 Workspace、删除和归档会结束它。行的归属见 [Attention 与消息](team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.zh.md)。

持有 Main stream 未读的写入者先读（`main_unread_required`）。`team/main-stream-read` 推进读者自己的 Main stream watermark 并消费 marker，两者都不变时不写入。

规则版本 2 起，只有 Project owner 能开 Thread（`team/thread-started`，kind 为 `discussion` 或 `task`），顶层 `team/message-sent` 不再写入；其他人得到 `project_owner_required`，并被指向 Main stream。

Thread 在 Main stream 以卡片出现，显示其当前状态：讨论显示 anchor 预览、回复数、发言者和最新活动；Task 显示编号、状态和活 Claim owner。版本 1 的顶层 Thread 按创建顺序显示为卡片，且永不未读。

规则版本 2 起，任何 Project member 都可在任意 Thread 回复。点名或回复指向只产生一个 direct marker，不开始也不恢复 Attention，Human 邀请确认流程不再存在。

## Message

Member 在 Project 或已有 Thread 中显式发出的不可变内容。Thread 由 `startThread` 创建，Main stream 消息从不创建 Thread：`postMainMessage` 写出的 Main stream Message 不属于任何 Thread，`startThread` 才写出 Thread 的 anchor。启动的 Thread 是 discussion，`kind: 'task'` 时才同时带上 Task；taskless Thread 之后可经 Human promotion 获得 Task。Thread Message 只延续已有 Thread。每条 Message 携带提交 operation 的 wall-clock 时刻；agent-facing 表面在固定的 UTC+8 协调时区下渲染该时刻。

## Task

贴在既有 Thread 上的一层可选 work-tracking overlay——Thread 不靠它存在。它可由顶层 Message 的显式「作为任务」意图创建，或由 Human promotion 追加。promotion 同时追加一条公开说明 Message。Task 的工作状态从 Claims 派生，验收与关闭是显式事实。面向 Human 的 `Task #N` 是 Task 在 home Project 内的 durable 创建序号；taskful 顶层发送和后续 promotion 均参与排序，taskless anchor 的原始位置不参与。它不是稳定身份；跨 Project 导航和持久引用必须使用 branded `taskRef`。

每个 Task 有一个 accountable owner 负责推进。Agent Project owner 创建 Task 时默认成为 accountable；Human 可按需在 enabled Project owners 与 Human 之间指定。执行由 Claim 承担，accountable 不等于执行者。`sourceThreadRefs` 不可变地指向同一 Project 的无 Task 来源讨论；有来源的 Task 在讨论中显示当前状态的只读卡片，不进入 Main stream。

常规验收要全部 Claim 完成（`in_review`）。Human 也可在 `in_progress` 时提前验收。accept 把当时仍 active 的 Claims 投影为 done，并在 activity 里记下 `completedClaimRefs`，通知各 owner，但不伪造他们的 claim-done 事件。从未被 claim 的 `todo` Task 可直接验收，activity 不携带 claim 列表。

Agent 只有在 Task 处于 `in_review`、自身是 Project owner 且从未持有该 Task 的任何 Claim（包括 released）时才能验收。执行过的 accountable 应请未参与执行的 owner 或 Human 验收，或转交责任。close、reopen、transfer 属于 Human 或当前 accountable；已结束 Task 只能由 Human 转交。转交不改变 Claims 的执行者。accountable Agent 被撤销 owner、离开 Workspace、归档或删除时，其负责的 open Task 在同一 operation 中转回 Human；suspend 不触发转交。

## Thread

Project 内独立的单层公开协作 aggregate：一定有 `threadRef`、anchor Message 和 revision，但可以没有 Task。Thread revision 随公开 Message 递增，Taskful Thread 的 Claim 变化和 Task resolution 也一样。往既有 Thread 公开写入时，必须带上该 Thread 的当前 revision。taskless Thread 仍支持 reply、follow、structured mention、Inbox、read 与 history，但没有 Claims、Task status 或 accept/close/reopen。协作读写定位优先用 `threadRef`。released task-only Client 可把 `taskRef` 用作仅限 taskful Thread 的 Host compatibility alias。Task/Claim 操作的身份仍是 `taskRef`。revision 是内部并发令牌，只在工具 baseRevision 里透传，不写进消息正文当引用事实。

## Direct Message

Member 之间的私有直达消息，不属于 Thread。ledger 只追加一条 audit-only 的 `team/dm-sent` operation。requestId 幂等，sender/recipient 必须是同 Workspace 的 enabled Agent Member。projection 有意不变：不产生 Project、Thread、revision、Attention 或 Inbox markers。送达是运行时的瞬时效果。收件人 idle 时以 relay-form user message 开一个 followup turn，busy 时 steer 进当前 turn。正文里带一行有界的相邻上下文（紧邻上一条往来 DM 的摘要）。注入失败不影响 durable 事实，发送方收到结构化 delivery error，不自动重投。DM 用于快速澄清与状态同步；任务工作、决策和需追溯的内容归 Thread。

## Claim

Member 针对 Task overlay 里某个 Direction 做出的工作承诺。taskless Thread 没有 Claim。Claim 的状态不是 active、done，就是 released；同一个 Task 里，规范化后相同的 Direction 至多有一个 active Claim。多个 Claims 是 dsh 对 Raft 单 owner 的刻意偏离：文本不同，也可能讲的是同一份工作。

## Direction

Claim 用自由文本写下的工作方向。比较时做 Unicode 规范化、去首尾空白、压缩连续空白、折叠大小写；不推断同义词。

## Thread Attention

一个 Member 对一个 Thread 的私有而持久的关注：记下当前关注周期的起点和连续的 read watermark。只要这个关注存在，就是 follow；它不进入公开 Thread revision。周期的开始与结束规则见 [attention-and-messaging.zh.md](team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.zh.md)。

## Thread Inbox

从 Thread Attention 与 direct mention 派生的 Member 级未读投影。它不是 Agent Session queue、浏览器状态或 per-message read 表。派生与读取语义见 [attention-and-messaging.zh.md](team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.zh.md)，工具契约见 [tools.zh.md](team-collaboration/tools.zh.md)。

## Follow

Follow 是 Thread Attention 的一种操作语义：不是独立的持久对象，也不是旧版 Delivery 订阅。普通 Thread 更新是否进该 Member 的 Inbox，由 follow 决定；它不撤销 Project 可见性。unfollow 在没有 active Claim 时结束当前 Attention 周期。

## Activity

Agent Team 记下的协作状态事实。Claim create/done/release 与 Task accept/close/reopen 是公开、revisioned Thread timeline facts。follow/unfollow 与 read-watermark 是 Attention audit facts，不进入公开协作时间线。Agent runtime error 可以摆在 Human UI 上当当前风险看。但它不是 ledger Thread Activity，也不是 Agent Inbox 事实。

## Inbox Hint

Host 从 durable Thread Inbox 状态里给 Agent 派生出的安全边界提示。提示有界：能唤醒 idle Agent，也能在 running Agent 的下一个安全步骤送达；它不代表模型已经读取、处理、回复或验收。恢复后照 durable unread 重新派生。

## Operation

Agent Team ledger 里一次不可变的原子业务提交。每个 Operation 有全局递增 sequence、稳定 operation id、幂等 request id、actor、一种业务事实和一个 wall-clock `occurredAt`。顺序与并发 authority 是 sequence，绝不是时刻。Thread fact envelope 会投影提交 operation 的时刻，让每条 fact 在任何重读路径上只看到一个值。

## Revision

特定 Thread 最近一次相关 Operation 的 sequence。Revision 是 optimistic concurrency fence，不是消息数量。

## Ref

跨重启稳定、带对象类型、调用者拼不出来的标识。Member、Project、Task、Thread、Message、Claim 和 Operation 使用不同的 branded refs。Attention 拿 Member 与 Thread 的组合当标识，不做成调用者能伪造的对象。

## Runtime Presence

Agent Member 在进程内的可用性投影，不是 ledger 事实。它取以下四态之一：

- available（live idle）；
- working（Agent loop running）；
- error（当前 loop/tool failure，保留到下一次 loop 启动）；
- unavailable：无可用 AgentHandle，或 lifecycle/setup/resume 阻止调用。这也包括 context rollover 的短暂窗口：ledger 绑定已迁移、新 Session 尚未就绪。

列表按状态点呈现，和 Claim 状态分开。

## Member Diagnostic（成员诊断）

presence/availability 行不正常时，背后的结构化原因（绝不持久化）：

- `session-refused`：激活所需 Session 的确定性格式拒绝。可携带被拒 artifact 路径，以及一次修复尝试是否证明存在可修内容。
- `session-unreadable`：missing、corrupt、io 或 unknown 的 Session 读取失败。
- `preset-composition`：preset 装载/校验失败，通常是安装与运行时分裂。
- `rollover`：换窗的短暂提交窗口。
- `runtime`：运行中的 loop 或 compaction 失败。
- `activation`：未分类的激活失败。

`class` 决定哪种恢复动作管用。没法修的拒绝和换窗窗口不给重启，其他的都可以用重启试着恢复。

## Context Generation（上下文代际）

一个 Member Session 的两个代际边界之间的工作上下文。全新代际从零开始：它第一眼看到的就是每步的常规注入（身份、`memory.md`、Workspace 列表）加上唤醒它的那条消息，且从不被告知换代发生过。ledger 记录当前绑定（任一时刻每个 Member 恰好一个）以及最近一次 transition 的上一 Session。上下文历史本身保存在各 Session 日志中。Member 身份、模型、私有记忆、skills、Claims 和 Attention，代代都保留。

换代完全是 Host 的决定，在唤醒边界做出。旧日志里仍可能带着早先版本写下的 checkpoint 锚点、rollover 对或 pending 意图；折叠层继续解码它们，让旧 ledger 与旧 Session 日志仍可读回，但当前构建不再产生其中任何一种。

## Suspend

把 Agent Member 的 live Agent 暂挂起来。成员身份、session、claims、Thread Attention、未读状态和私有 memory 都留着。Resume 回到同一个 session，要不要重新提示 Inbox，看 durable unread。

## Withdraw

从一个 workspace 离开：`team/member-workspace-left` 结束 Member 在该 workspace 的参与。退出其在该 workspace 的所有 project 成员关系。释放该 workspace 的 active claims 并清除其 Thread Attention。其余一切——Member 身份、其他参与、live session 及其 cwd、私有 memory——都不受影响。创建 Workspace 不可撤回，应改用全量归档。UI 把它放在非创建 workspace 的行上，当破坏性动作。

## Archive

藏在 Suspend 和 Remove 之间的第三态，Member 和 Project 都适用。设计上它可逆。事实完整留在 ledger 里，供重放和未来恢复。但本轮刻意不提供 restore 入口，与 dsh 的 archived session 对齐。`archiveMember` 放掉 live session。私有 memory 和 Session log 留在磁盘。它同时以一条公开 `claims_released` Activity，放掉全部参与 workspace 里的 active Claims。`archiveProject` 让 Project 上所有 Thread 的 owner 走同样的释放。Membership 在归档后保留（隐藏态，非退出）。Archived 实体从所有 Team API surface 消失。projection、mention 候选、ref 解析、ref-addressed read，一律以明确的 archived 错误拒绝。从 archived 状态 Remove 仍可以当数据清理用。

## Remove

把 Agent Member 不可逆地停用。Remove 释放 active claims、结束 Thread Attention、删除私有 memory、归档 session。历史 Message、Activity 和身份快照永久保留。

## Member Lifecycle

每个 durable Member state 的外部期望状态，一张表就够定义。每次 lifecycle operation 在 commit 后跑的正是这组 effect，Host 启动时也会给每个 Member 重跑一遍。所以 commit 和 effect 之间 crash 了、effect 失败了，重跑同一条推导就能收敛：

| State | Live handle | Session grouping | Private memory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | 一个，运行在记录的 binding 上 | active | 保留 |
| `suspended` | 无；resume 恢复同一 Session | 保留 | 保留 |
| `archived` | 无 | 归档（隐藏），log 留在磁盘 | 保留 |
| `inactive` | 无 | 归档 | 删除 |

每一步都只从 durable state 推导：crash 或调用失败后重跑，只补还欠的步骤，绝不再写一遍 durable 状态。
