验证方式：`npx tsc`（两个包）、`vitest`（相关 139 个用例全绿）、以及在 `/tmp/at-review/` 写的独立复现脚本（用仓库自身测试助手打开内存 ledger，复现旧格式记录重放）。

---

## 发现（按严重程度）

### Blocker 1 — 类型检查不通过，包无法构建

位置：`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:4705,4710,4714,4729,6344`

`AgentTeamAttentionSource` 没有从 `./types.ts` 导入。`npx tsc -p packages/agent-team/tsconfig.json --noEmit` 报 5 处 `TS2304: Cannot find name 'AgentTeamAttentionSource'`。

同一文件的第二处错误在 `ledger.ts:6349`：`withDefault` 的参数和返回类型是 `AgentTeamThreadAttention | AgentTeamMainAttention` 的联合，`inbox.attention.set.map(withDefault)` 因此推成联合数组，不能赋给 `readonly AgentTeamThreadAttention[]`。

第三处：`packages/agent-team/tests/legacy-main-attention.spec.ts:133` 构造无 `source` 的 Main attention 行，`TS2352` 转换失败（实体类型要求 `source`，存储层 schema 却可选）。

为什么测试没发现：vitest 用 esbuild 只剥类型、不做检查；`npm test` 也不跑 `tsc`。构建/发布（`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`）会直接失败。

最小修复：把 `AgentTeamAttentionSource` 加入 `ledger.ts` 类型导入；`withDefault` 改为两个具体类型的映射（或对两个数组分别内联映射）；测试里的构造加 `source` 或用 `as unknown as`。

---

### Blocker 2 — `team_task` 的 claim 路径在运行时抛 `ToolOutputError`

位置：`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:1048-1060`（输出 schema）、`1204-1206`（返回 `source`）、`1083`（渲染读取）

`team_task` 的 `output.schema` 是 `additionalProperties: false`，但没有声明 `source`；而 `execute` 在 `result.attention !== undefined` 时返回 `source`。Harness 会对每个成功结果做 schema 校验，多出的属性直接抛错：`/home/yu/projects/deepseek-harness/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1842-1843`。

具体场景：一个尚未关注该 Thread 的 Member 执行 `team_task action=claim`。ledger 的 `changeClaim` 返回 `attention`（source `'claim'`），工具返回对象含 `source`，结果校验失败，调用以错误结束——正好是这个功能要覆盖的那条路径。`tsc` 也在 `index.ts:1083` 报 `Property 'source' does not exist`。

现有渲染测试 `team-tools-render.spec.ts` 直接调用 `renderText`，绕过了 schema 校验，所以是绿的。

最小修复：在 `team_task` 输出 schema 里加 `source: { type: 'string' }`（`team_message` 和 `team_attention` 已加）。

---

### Blocker 3 — 旧 ledger 无法启动（三个校验器仍比较 source）

位置：`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:2946`、`3307`、`3401`

`repairLegacyAttentionSource` 只给缺 source 的行补一个统一默认值（v2 `'self'`、v1 `'mention'`），但以下校验器会用动作语义重新推导出**另一个** source，并且**没有**经过 `sourcelessDelta`：

- `2946` `team/project-owner-added`：`sameInboxDelta` 比较完整行，期望 `'project-owner'`。
- `3307` `team/claim-created`：比较完整行，期望 `'claim'`。
- `3401` `team/task-changed`（reopen 的 refollow）：比较完整行，期望 `'accountable'`。

复现结果（均通过真实 ledger 重放，仅把存储里的 Attention 行的 `source` 删掉以模拟上个版本写下的字节）：

| 场景 | 错误 |
|---|---|
| 普通 owner grant（成员原先未关注，grant 写了 Main attention 行） | `invalid Project owner inbox projection` |
| 成员首次 claim（非关注者） | `invalid Claim inbox projection` |
| Human close 后 reopen，accountable 重新关注 | `invalid Task inbox projection` |

构造函数里的 `replay()` 就会抛，所以不是“校验过严”，而是升级后根本打不开。这两个场景（owner grant、claim）在真实 ledger 里非常常见。文档 `host-authority.md` 说“A validator therefore compares an Attention row without its source”，与代码不符。

最小修复二选一：
1. 把这三处也改成 `sourcelessDelta` 比较（与已改的五处一致）。
2. 更好：让 `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 按操作种类推断真实 source（`team/project-owner-added` → `project-owner`；`team/claim-created` → `claim`；`team/thread-started` 无 activity → `thread-author`；有 activity 时按 `anchor.sender` 区分 `thread-author`/`accountable`；`team/task-changed` reopen 的 `refollowedMembers` → `accountable`；v1 `message-sent`/`thread-replied` → `mention`；attention-changed follow → `self`），这样校验器可以保持严格，顺带修掉 Blocker 4。

无论选哪种，现有测试都覆盖不到：`rulesV1Ledger` 只有 mention 行，`legacy-main-attention.spec.ts` 用的都是当前格式记录。需要补一个“无 source 的 v2 ledger”fixture。

---

### Major 4 — 覆盖式 grant 的修复逻辑对旧记录不再生效，会静默丢掉阅读进度

位置：`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:6386-6393`

`repairLegacyMainAttentionGrantOverwrite` 用 `isDeepStrictEqual(set, overwrite)` 判断“这正是旧版本无条件覆盖的那一行”，而 `overwrite` 现在由 `startMainAttention(..., 'project-owner')` 生成。旧记录的行没有 source，且先被 `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 补成了 `'self'`，两者永远不相等，修复不再触发。

后果不只是 Blocker 3 的启动失败：如果只修 Blocker 3 的校验器而放过这里，ledger 能启动，但那条覆盖行会被正常 apply，把 Member 自己的 `readThroughSequence` 重置到 grant，丢掉阅读进度——这正是这个修复函数存在的理由。`legacy-main-attention.spec.ts:82` 的测试用的是当前格式（带 source）的记录，所以仍然通过。

最小修复：比较时忽略 source（两侧都去掉），或采用 Blocker 3 的方案 2，让补出的 source 就是 `'project-owner'`。

---

### Minor 5 — 补出来的“原因”经常是错的（纯展示）

- v1 段的默认是 `'mention'`，但 v1 的 Claim 也会建立 Attention（`ledger.ts:3296` 不受 rulesVersion 限制），这些行会被显示为“because you were named in it”。代码注释 `ledger.ts:6340` 和文档“version-1 ... mention rule”的说法过于绝对。
- v2 段的旧行一律默认 `'self'`，但旧作者/claim/accountable 行都会显示成“because you chose to follow”。

因为 source 不参与任何行为（见末节），影响限于措辞。

### Minor 6 — 原因会过期，渲染用现在时

- owner grant 后又被撤销所有权：行按设计保留（`team/project-owner-removed` 不删 Main attention），`team_attention` 仍渲染“because you own the Project”。
- Task transfer 给他人后，原 accountable 的行仍在，渲染“because you are accountable for its Task”。
- Claim release 后行仍保留，渲染“because you claimed its Task”。

具体输入：Agent A 被 grant owner（行 source `project-owner`）→ Human 撤销 A 的所有权 → A 调 `team_attention status`，输出包含“following the Main stream (because you own the Project)”。最小修复：措辞改为过去时（“because you were named…”），或在渲染时按当前状态校正。

### Nit 7 — 两个默认值不一致

`ledger.ts:4173-4174` 的 `withSource` 一律补 `'self'`，`repairLegacyAttentionSource` 在 v1 段补 `'mention'`。当前没有任何路径会让未修复的行进入 `applyInboxDelta`（repair 在 `sortedRecords` 里已经覆盖所有带 inbox 的记录），所以构造不出具体失败；但这是同一个事实的两套默认值，建议收敛为一处。

### Nit 8 — 未知 source 会渲染成 `(undefined)`

`tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:387,853,1083` 用 `CAUSE_OF_SOURCE[value.source]`，`Record<string,string>` 的索引在运行时可能是 `undefined`；结果 schema 只约束 `type: 'string'`。宿主目前只会产出六个枚举值，构造不出真实失败；加固方式是给 `CAUSE_OF_SOURCE` 加兜底或把 schema 改成 `enum`。

---

## 逐条回答指定场景

1. **`sourcelessDelta` 是否放得过宽**：是，两个不同 source 现在比较相等，写错 cause 的记录也能通过校验（且没有任何测试能发现写入方把 source 写错）。但 source 不参与任何推导，所以损失只是“标签可能是错的”，不是行为错误。真正的问题不是它放得宽，而是它只加在了 5 个校验器上（即 Blocker 3）。
2. **版本相关默认值**：时序是对的。`sortedRecords()` 逐条先 repair 再 `applyTo`，`projection.rulesVersion` 反映该记录写入时生效的版本；adoption 严格递增（`ledger.ts:2956`），且 v1-only 的 `team/message-sent` 在 adoption 之后会被拒绝（`2859-2863`），所以不存在“adoption 之后出现 v1 行”的情况。问题在前提本身：v1 行不全是 mention（见 Minor 5）。
3. **`dropMainAttention`**：没有构造出失败。`mainAttentionKey` 仍是唯一 key 构造点（`ledger.ts:592`），key 形如 `member:<id>|project:<id>`；Member id 只由 `member:${randomUUID()}` 和 `member:human` 产生，不含 `|`。schema 的正则 `/^member:[^:]+$/` 本身允许 `|`，但没有任何受支持路径能造出这样的 id，且前缀带分隔符，`member:a` 不会误删 `member:ab|…`。
4. **Human 的 `project-owner` 硬编码**：没有发现应读成其他值的路径。Human 的行由 Project 派生（`humanMainAttentionFrom`），follow 会被“已在关注”拒绝，unfollow 被拒绝，delta 里也不会出现 `member:human` 的 Main attention 行。
5. **渲染路径**：(a) 未关注时的 guard 正确（`value.following === false || value.source === undefined`）；(b) `team_message` 的 start 在无 source 时不会输出该行，不会出现 `undefined`，reply 也受 `action !== 'start'` 保护；(c) `team_task` 的 claim 分支之外没有读 `value.source`。但 (c) 的 `source` 根本进不了 `render`，见 Blocker 2。
6. **是否有行为依赖 source**：没有，见下节。

---

## source 是否承重

**纯展示用，不承载任何行为。**

- 写入后只被三处读取：`repairLegacyAttentionSource`（只判断 `=== undefined` 后填默认值，`ledger.ts:6337-6346`）、`applyInboxDelta` 的 `withSource`（同样只判断是否缺失，`4173-4174`）、工具渲染（`tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:387,853,1083`）。
- 校验路径明确丢弃它：`sourcelessDelta`（`ledger.ts:3675-3684`）在 5 个校验器里把两侧的 source 都剥掉。
- 全仓库没有对 `attention.source` 取值做分支、排序、过滤或投递判断的代码。`records covered`、unread、notice、inbox、Remote、Client 都不读它。

因此 Blocker 3/4 是存储重放层面的真实回归，而不是展示层问题；而“伪造 source”最多只影响结果里的一句措辞。</result>

<result>## Review: Attention `source` field (23ed8ee + 0a19c52, base d807a27)

I read the full diff, ran the repository gates (`check:comments`, `check:docs`, the two changed spec files: 133 pass), and reproduced the two blockers below in a throwaway copy of the tree beside the repo (no file in the reviewed tree was edited).

### Blocker 1 — `team_task` claim now fails at runtime with an output-schema error

`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:1048-1058` (declared `team_task` output, `additionalProperties: false`) vs `:1202-1206` (execute returns `source`).

The claim commit value now carries `source`, but the `team_task` output schema never declares it. `ToolRunner.createSuccessResult` validates every value with `validateJsonSchemaValue` and throws `ToolOutputError` on a violation (`deepseek-harness/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1841-1843`). Verified: validating the exact execute-shaped value against the declared schema returns `"value.source" is not a declared property (additionalProperties: false)`.

Consequence: every successful Claim that starts the executor's Attention (the normal case) commits to the ledger and then the tool call errors — the model never sees the result. The CHANGELOG line "a Claim result … names the Attention it just established" and `docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:57` therefore document behavior that does not happen.

Rule: AGENTS.md — "Update the affected maintained document, package README, and tests when a non-trivial change alters a public contract or workflow"; the output schema is that contract. `docs/AGENTS.md` — "never record behavior the code does not implement."

Smallest fix: add `source: { type: 'string' }` to the `team_task` output properties. Also add a test that runs the execute-shaped value through `validateJsonSchemaValue`; `renderText` bypasses the schema, which is why the new render test passes.

### Blocker 2 — a ledger written by the previous build cannot be loaded

`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:2946` (`sameInboxDelta`), `:3307` (Claim), `:3401` (Task close/reopen; `reopenThreadInboxFrom` mints an `'accountable'` row at `:4623-4624`).

`repairLegacyAttentionSource` (:6334) fills a missing source with `self`/`mention`, but four replay validators still compare the inbox with plain `isDeepStrictEqual`/`sameInboxDelta`, which compares `source` too. I took a ledger written by `d807a27`, stripped `source` exactly as that build wrote rows, and reopened it. Results:

- claim-created row: `Error: invalid Claim inbox projection`
- Agent ownership grant main row: `Error: invalid Project owner inbox projection`

Consequence: upgrading any Host whose ledger contains a Claim that established Attention, or an Agent Project owner, throws during replay and the ledger does not load. This contradicts the change's own storage rule ("rows written before it existed keep their bytes") in CHANGELOG.md:22 and `docs/architecture/host-authority.md:17`.

Rule: AGENTS.md — "packages/agent-team is the only Team authority. Its append-only operation ledger is the durable source of Team facts"; `docs/AGENTS.md` — "Source and tests define implementation behavior."

Smallest fix: make every Attention-bearing replay comparison source-insensitive, e.g. route all of them (including the normalization inside `sameInboxDelta`) through `sourcelessDelta`. Add a replay test that strips `source` from a ledger containing a Claim and an ownership grant; the new test at `agent-team-attention.spec.ts:2075` only exercises the v1 message fixture, where every affected comparison happens to use `sourcelessDelta`.

### Major 3 — the legacy source default is wrong in both rules versions, and the docs repeat it

`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:6340-6346`; `docs/architecture/host-authority.md:17`; `docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:8` vs `:17`.

The fallback is chosen per rules-version segment: v1 → `mention`, v2 → `self`. Neither is accurate for a segment's non-mention rows. v1 could write explicit follows (`team/thread-attention-changed`, introduced in `c28fba7`) and Claims, whose rows are not mentions. A v1 row therefore reads "because you were named in it" for a follow or a claim. Meanwhile `attention-and-messaging.md:8` says an unattributable row "reads as the Member's own choice" while `host-authority.md:17` says v1 rows read as `mention` — two maintained documents state different rules for the same fact.

The third new test (`agent-team-attention.spec.ts:2075-2087`) is not vacuous — it asserts the loaded rows are non-empty and all `mention` — but it locks in this rule using a fixture that only contains message/reply operations, so it never exercises the mislabeled v1 kinds.

Rules: `docs/AGENTS.md` — "One fact has one maintained home; cross-link between documents instead of duplicating the fact" and "never record behavior the code does not implement."

Smallest coherent fix: follow the principle already written in the repair comment and `attention-and-messaging.md`: use `self` for every row whose cause cannot be known (drop the version split), delete the "version-1 … rows read as `mention`" clause from `host-authority.md`, and update the test fixture expectation. `mention` stays in the enum because this build still writes it for v1 replies (`ledger.ts:1226`). If exact historical attribution is wanted instead, derive it from the operation kind in the repair — do not keep the coarse per-version guess.

### Minor 4 — the phrase table is not keyed to the enum

`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:349` — `CAUSE_OF_SOURCE: Record<string, string>` and `source?: string` result fields.

Indexing a `Record<string, string>` is typed as non-optional, so a value outside the enum renders literal `(undefined)` and a seventh source added later compiles silently. Rule: AGENTS.md — "Keep one authoritative formatter/projection per domain concept." Fix: `Record<AgentTeamAttentionSource, string>` and import the type from `@contexera/dsh-agent-team/types` for `mainAttentionResult`/`attentionResult`/`messageOutcome`/claim result. The six-entry table itself is the right mechanism (not a speculative registry): each value is produced by a real path.

### Minor 5 — dead fallback authority: `withSource`

`packages/agent-team/src/ledger.ts:4173-4186`.

Every replay passes through `sortedRecords()` → `repairLegacyAttentionSource`, and every live write must supply a source because `AgentTeamThreadAttention.source` is now required by the type. So `applyInboxDelta` never sees a sourceless row; the mapper cannot fire. It also disagrees with the repair default (`self` always vs the version split). Rule: AGENTS.md — "Do not add speculative registries, compatibility layers, fallback authorities, or duplicate stores." Fix: delete `withSource` and restore `applyInboxDelta(target, delta)`; `repairLegacyAttentionSource` remains the single defaulting point.

### Minor 6 — one fact, two maintained homes

`docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:8` and `docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:57` (and their `.zh.md` halves) both state which results render the cause. The routing table gives the tool result contract to `tools.md` and the row semantics to `attention-and-messaging.md`. This is duplicated, not cross-linked. Fix: keep the render behavior in `tools.md`; in `attention-and-messaging.md` drop the "`team_attention` renders it … Claim or Thread start names …" sentence or link to `tools.md`.

### Minor 7 — `CAUSE_OF_SOURCE` orphans the `teamAttention` doc comment

`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:347-357`. The const was inserted between the `/** Attention (following a Thread) … */` comment and `const teamAttention`, so the comment now documents `CAUSE_OF_SOURCE` and the tool has none. Rule: AGENTS.md — "Keep production code self-explanatory through clear names, types, and structure." Fix: move the const above the existing comment.

`packages/tool-agent-team/tests/team-tools-render.spec.ts:839-884`. Exact phrases are asserted only for `project-owner`, `claim`, and `thread-author`; the loop over the other three only asserts `/\(because [a-z]/`, so swapping the `accountable` and `mention` phrases would pass. More importantly, `renderText` bypasses output validation entirely (see Blocker 1). `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 只给缺 source 的行补一个统一默认值（v2 `'self'`、v1 `'mention'`），但以下校验器会用动作语义重新推导出**另一个** source，并且**没有**经过 `sourcelessDelta`：

- `3307` `team/claim-created`：比较完整行，期望 `'claim'`。
- `3401` `team/task-changed`（reopen 的 refollow）：比较完整行，期望 `'accountable'`。

复现结果（均通过真实 ledger 重放，仅把存储里的 Attention 行的 `source` 删掉以模拟上个版本写下的字节）：

| 场景 | 错误 |
|---|---|
| 普通 owner grant（成员原先未关注，grant 写了 Main attention 行） | `invalid Project owner inbox projection` |
| 成员首次 claim（非关注者） | `invalid Claim inbox projection` |
| Human close 后 reopen，accountable 重新关注 | `invalid Task inbox projection` |

构造函数里的 `replay()` 就会抛，所以不是“校验过严”，而是升级后根本打不开。这两个场景（owner grant、claim）在真实 ledger 里非常常见。文档 `host-authority.md` 说“A validator therefore compares an Attention row without its source”，与代码不符。

1. 把这三处也改成 `sourcelessDelta` 比较（与已改的五处一致）。
2. 更好：让 `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 按操作种类推断真实 source（`team/project-owner-added` → `project-owner`；`team/claim-created` → `claim`；`team/thread-started` 无 activity → `thread-author`；有 activity 时按 `anchor.sender` 区分 `thread-author`/`accountable`；`team/task-changed` reopen 的 `refollowedMembers` → `accountable`；v1 `message-sent`/`thread-replied` → `mention`；attention-changed follow → `self`），这样校验器可以保持严格，顺带修掉 Blocker 4。

### Major 4 — 覆盖式 grant 的修复逻辑对旧记录不再生效，会静默丢掉阅读进度

1. **`sourcelessDelta` 是否放得过宽**：是，两个不同 source 现在比较相等，写错 cause 的记录也能通过校验（且没有任何测试能发现写入方把 source 写错）。但 source 不参与任何推导，所以损失只是“标签可能是错的”，不是行为错误。真正的问题不是它放得宽，而是它只加在了 5 个校验器上（即 Blocker 3）。
2. **版本相关默认值**：时序是对的。`sortedRecords()` 逐条先 repair 再 `applyTo`，`projection.rulesVersion` 反映该记录写入时生效的版本；adoption 严格递增（`ledger.ts:2956`），且 v1-only 的 `team/message-sent` 在 adoption 之后会被拒绝（`2859-2863`），所以不存在“adoption 之后出现 v1 行”的情况。问题在前提本身：v1 行不全是 mention（见 Minor 5）。

content.text:
两个评审轴都跑完了，各自独立发现了真问题。**我上一轮交的东西是坏的**，三个 blocker 全部证实并已修。

## 三个 blocker

**1. 类型检查其实没过。** 我第一轮汇报时说 typecheck 干净——那是错的。我用 `grep -c "error TS"` 数到 0，但错误是以 `TypertAnalysisError` 从 typert 生成器抛出的，不是 `tsc` 行。真实错误是 `withDefault` 的联合类型映射推成联合数组，赋不回 `readonly AgentTeamThreadAttention[]`。度量方式错了，不是检查过了。**这条最该记：判断类型检查得看退出码和完整输出。**

**2. `team_task` 输出 schema 没声明 `source`，而 `execute` 返回它。** `additionalProperties: false` 直接抛 `ToolOutputError`——正好打在这个功能要覆盖的 claim 路径上：ledger 提交成功，工具调用以错误结束，模型根本看不到结果。这条被 `member-lifecycle-core.spec.ts` 的真实集成测试抓住。我加的渲染测试抓不到，因为 `renderText` 绕过 schema 校验。

**3. 旧账本打不开。** 三个校验器（owner grant / claim / task-changed）仍完整比较 source。我用探针复现了：剥掉 source 的 owner grant → `invalid Project owner inbox projection`。这跟第一轮我修的是同一类错误，又犯了一次。

## 第 3 条的修法改变了设计

评审给了两个选项，我选了更好的那个，因为它顺带解决了另一个问题：

不再「按规则版本猜默认值 + 校验时剥掉 source」，改成**从 operation 种类推导真实 source**：

| operation | source |
|---|---|
| `project-owner-added` | `project-owner` |
| `claim-created` | `claim` |
| `thread-started` | `thread-author` |
| `task-changed` / `task-accountable-changed` | `accountable` |

这样校验可以保持严格，`sourcelessDelta` 和 `withSource` 两个补丁全部删掉——前者是过度放行（写错 cause 也能过），后者是与 repair 不一致的第二套默认值。

评审还指出「按版本猜」错在哪：**v1 段不全是 mention**，v1 也能显式 follow 和 claim。改成按 operation 推导后这个问题自然消失。

## 现在的状态

`3fb6bed` + `8a23163`。**1418 passed / 1 skipped**，六个 check 全过，`npm run typecheck` 真的干净了。

新增的回归测试都做了消融验证：删掉 `team_task` 的 schema 声明 → 1 个测试红；把 grant 的 source 改成 `self` → 2 个测试红。其中 schema 那条我第一版也写错了——断言成 `not.toThrow()`，而 `validateJsonSchemaValue` 是**返回**违规列表不是抛错，所以永远通过。改成断言返回空列表后才真正承重。

报告已更新，教训也存进 memory 了——特别是 typecheck 那条，是我自己方法上的错。

# .scratch Work Rules

This subtree holds cross-session work items: design snapshots, research, implementation tickets, prototypes, and acceptance evidence. It is not an implementation or API authority — current behavior is defined by `packages/` source and tests, and maintenance rules by [`../docs/AGENTS.md`](../docs/AGENTS.md). This file only governs how to work here.

## Work-item structure

Each `active/<work>/` is one directory with a short `README.md` as its single continuation entry, covering five items: status, last-checked date, current frontier (who is doing what and what is blocked), completion conditions, and the formal-doc exit.

```
active/<work>/
├── README.md      # continuation entry (the five items above)
├── spec.md        # confirmed decision snapshot — written once discussion converges
├── issues/        # tracer-bullet implementation tickets, one file per ticket
│   ├── 01-<slug>.md
│   └── 02-<slug>.md
├── materials/     # research and external material (keep only what is worth re-reading)
└── validation/    # human-confirmed acceptance evidence (see the development doc)
```

## Ticket discipline

Each `issues/NN-<slug>.md` uses a fixed skeleton, numbered from `01` in dependency order (blockers first):

```markdown
# NN — title

**What to build:** the end-to-end behavior this ticket demonstrably delivers once done (user perspective, not a layered task list)
**Blocked by:** the tickets blocking it, or "None — can start immediately"
**Status:** pending | ready | in-progress | complete

- [ ] acceptance criterion 1
- [ ] acceptance criterion 2
```

- **Vertical slices**: each ticket cuts one narrow, complete path through every layer (schema → API → UI → tests), independently verifiable when done; no horizontal division of labor by layer.
- **Self-contained tickets**: each ticket can start in a new context without reading the whole work-item history. Avoid concrete file paths and code snippets (they go stale); exception: decision-dense fragments from prototypes (state machines, type shapes) may be inlined with their source noted.
- **Frontier workflow**: tickets whose blockers are all done form the frontier and are ready to start; a serial chain runs top to bottom. Tickets that are written but still carry unfinished blockers stay **pending**, so `ready` always means startable now.
- **Wide-refactor exception**: when one mechanical change's blast radius covers the whole repository, do not force it into a tracer bullet — order it as expand–contract: expand first (old and new coexist), migrate in batches, then contract (delete the old form).

## Lifecycle

- **Closing a work item**: close or delete unfinished tickets → move durable conclusions into the `../docs/` maintained documents → delete process material without provenance value → move into `archive/YYYY-MM/`.
- **Archive is history**: archived states and terminology only represent the working context of their time and never override current implementation; do not rewrite archives to match new code.
- **Transient artifacts**: logs, debug screenshots, and downloads go in `local/` or `artifacts/` (gitignored), never into active or archive.

## Version control

- **Active does not enter version history**: while a work item is open, its `active/<work>/` directory is gitignored working material. Force-add it (`git add -f`) only when a reviewer must see it.
- **Archive enters history on close**: when a work item closes, move it into `archive/YYYY-MM/` and amend that move into the commit(s) that deliver the work, so the archive records what actually shipped instead of sitting in a scratch-only commit at the tip.

## Directory index

See [README.md](README.md).

# 05 — Agent 对 follow/unfollow 的指导

**What to build:** 一个 Agent 在被自动关注、主动 follow/unfollow、被拒绝 unfollow、或收到一次性直接通知时，从工具结果里得到一致且简短的说明：现在关注什么、为什么、unfollow 后哪些信号仍然到达、如何恢复。稳定语义（follow/unfollow 不改变 Project 归属、Task 责任和 Claim 状态）进入 persona / core skill，不在每次结果里重复整段教学。

**Blocked by:** 04 — 默认 Attention 与身份变化（已完成）

**Status:** complete — 工具面、文案与稳定规则已落地；呈现机制的通用化归 `agent-tools-context-rendering`

- [x] persona / core skill 说明稳定规则：follow 持续接收普通更新；unfollow 停止普通更新；unfollow 不影响 @、回复、责任事件和 reminder；unfollow 不等于退出 Project、放弃 Task 或释放 Claim；有 active Claim 时不能 unfollow
- [x] 自动建立关注的结果说明对象与已知来源（owner / accountable / Claim / Thread 作者），并说明普通更新会自动到达、如何 unfollow
- [x] 显式 follow 成功说明从当前开始的普通更新会到达、更早内容可主动读取；unfollow 成功说明普通更新停止、直接与责任信号保留、可再次 follow
- [x] 有 active Claim 而拒绝 unfollow 时，说明需要先完成或释放 Claim
- [x] Thread / Main stream 读取结果用一行说明当前关注状态与后果，不重复教学；@ 与 reply 不自动建立持续关注这一事实在接收者自己的读取或关注查询中说明，而非在每次向他人发消息时重复
- [x] 呈现层的具体文案与预算遵循 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 的统一机制；本票只负责 Attention 用例的语义完整
- [x] 单测覆盖上述每个场景的说明文案，测试断言语义而非逐字匹配可调措辞

## 实施说明

- `team_attention` 新增 `projectRef` 寻址（Main stream 面），与 `threadRef`/`taskRef` 互斥；同传两者或三者皆空都被拒绝，并给出恢复指引。
- `team_attention` 的 render 现在带一句「后果」：
  - following → `Ordinary updates from there will interrupt you; mentions, replies and responsibility events already did.`
  - not following → `Ordinary updates will no longer interrupt you. Mentions, replies and responsibility events still will; follow again to resume.`
- `team_thread` 的 Main stream read 加一行 `Attention: following / not following`（not following 时给出 follow 的入口）；Thread read 在未关注时追加一句同类提示。两者都不重复整段教学。
- persona 与 `team-domain-model` core skill 的旧「owner 攒 5 条」规则已删除，改为「没有更慢的等级」；core skill 新增 owner 授权只 follow Main stream、unfollow 不放弃责任等稳定规则。
- core skill 有 7850 字符硬预算（dsh-developer 上限减 150 余量），因此细节留在工具结果与 render 中，skill 只放稳定规则——这正是 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 要统一的「常驻与按需」分界。
- 测试在 `team-tools-render.spec.ts` 中断言语义（含「unfollow 后 mention/reply/责任事件仍到达」），不断言整段逐字。

## 未做（明确不在本票）

- ~~自动建立关注时说明「为什么 follow」~~ **已完成（2026-10-28）**：Attention 行新增 `source` 字段，六种来源 `thread-author` / `claim` / `accountable` / `project-owner` / `mention` / `self`。reopen 归入 `accountable`（它是「恢复」而非「新建」，与被指定 accountable 同源）。`team_attention` 在已 follow 时渲染原因；Claim 与 Thread start 说明自己刚建立的 Attention。存储上可选，因此旧账本字节不变；重放校验不比较它。
- 未把文案收进统一的语义视图层——等 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 定型后再迁移，避免现在造一个会被推翻的抽象。
